title: A stress test for unobserved confounders
Does the payment vehicle matter for valuing improved electricity reliability? A discrete choice experiment in Ethiopia
abstract: Frequent and prolonged power outages severely impede business operations in many developing countries. Given resource constraints, estimating the value of improved electricity reliability in such contexts is crucial for justifying related investments. This analysis uses a split-sample design to examine whether business enterprises in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, have different valuations for improved power supply reliability under two payment vehicles (electricity bill increases and tax revenue allocation). Results show that these businesses are willing to pay (WTP) an average of US$33 per year for a 1-h monthly reduction in outages and US$24 per year for one less outage per month. These amounts represent approximately 11% and 8% of the typical annual electricity bill of 10,615 Birr (US$295), respectively, highlighting that businesses place substantial value on electricity reliability. We find no significant differences in preferences or WTP estimates between the bill and tax payment vehicle sub-samples, suggesting that tax payment vehicles are as credible as bill increases in stated preference studies and that multiple mechanisms for financing power reliability investments may be feasible in practice. Highlights • Used a split sample design to elicit WTP for improved electricity reliability in Ethiopia. • Business enterprises are WTP more for a better quality of electricity supply. • No significant difference between bill and tax payment vehicles.
abstract_zh: 频繁且持久的停电严重阻碍了许多发展中国家的企业经营。在资源有限的情况下，估算在这种背景下改善电力可靠性的价值，对于论证相关投资的合理性至关重要。本分析采用分样本设计，考察埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴的企业在两种支付方式（电费上涨与税收分配）下，对改善供电可靠性的估值是否存在差异。结果显示，这些企业愿意为每月停电时间减少1小时支付平均每年33美元，为每月减少一次停电支付平均每年24美元。这些金额分别约占典型年度电费（10,615比尔（Birr），即295美元）的11%和8%，表明企业高度重视电力可靠性。我们发现，电费与税收两种支付方式的子样本之间，在偏好或支付意愿估计值上没有显著差异，这表明在陈述偏好研究中，税收支付方式与电费上涨同样可信，而且在实践中，为电力可靠性投资融资的多种机制可能是可行的。研究亮点：• 采用分样本设计，获取埃塞俄比亚改善电力可靠性的支付意愿。• 企业对更高质量的电力供应支付更高的意愿。• 电费与税收支付方式之间不存在显著差异。

title: We Need the Largest Experiments on Earth to Achieve Our Climate Targets
abstract: Natural Climate Solutions (NCS) are the climate mitigation sector with the largest potential, yet the least investment. A major barrier to scaling NCS is lack of evidence-based scientific learning at the scale of actual interventions. To overcome this gap, we propose the world's largest field experiments, supported by a global data-sharing platform and guided by a clear framework of ethical principles and guidelines for delivering robust NCS evidence. This involves consistently reporting outcomes in units of MgCO2e $-1 yr-1 while describing direct and enabling actor groups and their financial, policy, and information interactions.
abstract_zh: 自然气候解决方案（NCS）是潜力最大、但投资却最少的气候减缓领域。扩大NCS规模的一个主要障碍是，缺乏在实际干预规模上进行的、基于证据的科学学习。为弥补这一空白，我们提议开展全球规模最大的田野实验，并辅以全球数据共享平台，同时以明确的伦理原则和指南框架为指导，以提供稳健的NCS证据。这需要以MgCO2e·$⁻¹·yr⁻¹为单位持续报告结果，同时描述直接与间接行动者群体及其在财务、政策和信息方面的相互作用。

title: Critical mineral mining in the energy transition: A systematic review of environmental, social, and governance risks and opportunities
abstract: To address climate change, countries must decarbonize and shift to renewable energy. Renewables like solar and wind are mineral intensive, meaning the world must rapidly scale up mining and processing of critical minerals such as lithium and cobalt. Such an energy transition offers economic opportunities, but poses serious environmental, social, and governance (ESG) risks. Scholars have begun to identify these risks and opportunities, yet no systematic synthesis exists. Further, non-legal academic literature on this topic frequently fails to engage a growing legal scholarship. We reviewed 69 articles focusing on critical mineral mining in the context of energy transition to describe the state of the literature and synthesize information on ESG risks and opportunities. We drew on non-legal and legal scholarship, making this the first systematic review on this topic to unite both literatures. We find that 60 % of papers focus on two minerals – lithium and/or cobalt – leaving other vitally important critical minerals unexplored. There are also glaring geographic holes – for example, the lithium papers focus on South America's Lithium Triangle, largely missing top producer Australia and other players. Collectively, the articles identify 26 ESG factors, comprising 18 risks and 8 opportunities. While this review provides a strong synthesis of existing scholarship, it reveals a clear gap between what we know and what is needed to accelerate global energy transition. There is pressing need for scholarship on overlooked critical minerals and regions, ESG opportunities in addition to risks, ownership models, and governance solutions such as impact benefit agreements.
abstract_zh: 为应对气候变化，各国必须实现脱碳并转向可再生能源。太阳能和风能等可再生能源属于矿产密集型能源，这意味着世界必须迅速扩大锂、钴等关键矿产的开采与加工。这种能源转型带来了经济机遇，但也带来了严重的环境、社会和治理（ESG）风险。学者们已开始识别这些风险与机遇，但尚不存在系统性的综合研究。此外，关于该主题的非法学学术文献往往未能与日益增多的法学研究形成对话。我们审阅了69篇聚焦于能源转型背景下关键矿产开采的文献，以描述该领域文献的现状，并综合有关ESG风险与机遇的信息。我们同时借鉴了非法学与法学研究，使其成为首篇将两类文献结合起来的、关于该主题的系统性综述。我们发现，60%的论文聚焦于两种矿产——锂和/或钴，而其他至关重要的关键矿产则尚未得到探讨。地理上的空白也十分明显——例如，关于锂的论文集中于南美洲的“锂三角”，基本忽略了头号生产国澳大利亚及其他参与者。这些文章共识别出26项ESG因素，其中包括18项风险和8项机遇。尽管本综述对现有学术成果作了有力的综合，但它也揭示了我们已知的内容与加速全球能源转型所需内容之间的明显差距。迫切需要针对被忽视的关键矿产和地区的研究、ESG机遇（而不仅是风险）、所有权模式，以及诸如影响效益协议等治理方案的学术研究。

title: Estimating Lost Dividends from Incomplete Energy Access Transitions
abstract: Energy access is often considered a catalyst for development. Yet, the binary classification of household electrification misses important variation in service quality and in how households use electricity. To examine the benefits of household electrification and illustrate the importance of using more nuanced classifications of energy access, this article develops a metric called the Energy Access Dividend (EAD), which quantifies the electrification benefits forgone due to slow and incomplete energy transitions. This framework is flexible, allowing for the estimation of a variety of electrification benefits such as reduced lighting and cell phone charging expenditures, environmental improvements, time use and asset ownership changes, and improvements associated with productive energy use. To demonstrate the applicability of this framework, we calculate the EAD for several proposed electrification trajectory alternatives in Honduras. We find that in Honduras, a country with high rates of basic electricity access, achieving immediate universal, high-quality electricity would generate nearly $697 million in benefits over the period leading up to 2050. We also estimate the EADs associated with more limited immediate electrification as well as geographically based electrification scenarios, demonstrating that these calculations can inform priorities for energy policy design.
abstract_zh: 能源可及性常被视为发展的催化剂。然而，将家庭是否通电进行二元划分，忽略了供电质量的重要差异以及家庭使用电力方式的差异。为考察家庭通电的效益，并说明采用更细致的能源可及性分类的重要性，本文提出了一个名为“能源可及红利”（EAD）的指标，用以量化因能源转型缓慢和不完全而失去的通电效益。该框架具有灵活性，可以估计多种通电效益，例如减少照明和手机充电支出、环境改善、时间利用与资产拥有状况的变化，以及与生产性能源利用相关的改善。为展示该框架的适用性，我们计算了洪都拉斯若干拟议通电路径方案的能源可及红利。我们发现，在基本电力可及率已经很高的洪都拉斯，若立即实现普遍的高质量供电，到2050年之前将产生近6.97亿美元的效益。我们还估计了更为有限的即时通电方案以及基于地理区域的通电情景所对应的能源可及红利，表明这些计算可以为能源政策设计的优先次序提供参考。

title: Forest Fires, Smoky Kitchens, and Human Health in Indonesia
abstract: Burning tropical forests to establish lucrative agricultural crops ignores potentially important health externalities of the resulting air pollution. These health externalities are often poorly understood, especially if other environmental hazards, such as indoor pollution, are not taken into account. Given the potential for joint, contemporaneous harms, we estimate the impacts of outdoor and indoor air pollution on respiratory health in Indonesia. To address the endogeneity of air pollution exposure, we use panel fixed effects estimation and instrument for outdoor pollution using upwind forest fire intensity. We find that outdoor air pollution exposure reduces lung capacity and decreases overall health status. Subgroup analysis reveals that these impacts are higher among the youngest and oldest individuals in our sample. Critically, we find suggestive evidence that outdoor air pollution exposure is more harmful to the health of individuals living in households that use clean cooking fuels. Thus, policies aimed at reducing environmental health harms are not substitutable—that is, reductions in both indoor and outdoor air pollution exposures are necessary for achieving health targets.
abstract_zh: 为建立利润丰厚的农业作物而焚烧热带森林，忽视了由此产生的空气污染可能带来的重要健康外部性。这些健康外部性往往理解不足，特别是如果未将室内污染等其他环境危害纳入考虑。鉴于可能存在的同时发生的复合危害，我们估计了室外和室内空气污染对印度尼西亚呼吸系统健康的影响。为解决空气污染暴露的内生性问题，我们使用面板固定效应估计，并以上风向的森林火灾强度作为室外污染的工具变量。我们发现，室外空气污染暴露会降低肺活量，并使总体健康状况变差。分组分析表明，这些影响在样本中最年轻和最年长的人群中更为严重。尤为关键的是，我们发现有初步证据表明，室外空气污染暴露对使用清洁烹饪燃料的家庭中个体的健康更为有害。因此，旨在减少环境健康危害的政策之间不可相互替代——也就是说，要实现健康目标，必须同时减少室内和室外的空气污染暴露。

title: Gendered demand for environmental health technologies: Evidence of complementarities from stove auctions in India
venue: Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics
abstract: We study if prior exposure to one environmental health technology – improved sanitation – complements or substitutes for additional household investments in another such technology — an electric induction cookstove. We conducted a cookstove demand revealing auction ten years after a random half of our sample had been exposed to an intensive sanitation promotion campaign in rural India. We observe that demand for induction cookstoves among men seems to be affected by information they obtain following the sanitation intervention, whereas preferences and demand among women, who likely have more at stake, are unchanged. This points to the importance of understanding interactions between gender, information, knowledge, and preferences for technology, and decision-making power over adoption of the solutions needed to achieve environmental health targets.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了此前接触一种环境健康技术——改善卫生设施——是否会补充或替代家庭对另一种此类技术——电磁炉——的额外投资。在印度农村，我们的样本中随机选取的一半家庭接受了为期密集的卫生设施推广运动，十年后，我们开展了一次炉具需求揭示拍卖。我们观察到，男性对电磁炉的需求似乎受到卫生设施干预之后所获信息的影响，而女性（她们可能有更大的利害关系）的偏好和需求则未发生变化。这表明，理解性别、信息、知识和技术偏好之间的相互作用，以及在实现环境健康目标所需解决方案的采纳决策中的决策权，具有重要意义。

title: Mitigating agricultural residue burning: challenges and solutions across land classes in Punjab, India
abstract: India faces significant air quality challenges, contributing to local health and global climate concerns. Despite a national ban on agricultural residue burning and various incentive schemes, farmers in northern India continue to face difficulties in curbing open-field burning. Using data from 1021 farming households in rural Punjab in India, we examine the patterns and drivers of the adoption of no-burn agriculture, particularly for farmers who mulch instead of burning crop residue. We find a growing trend in no-burn farming practices among farmers between 2015 and 2017, with the highest adoption rates among large farmers compared to medium and small farmers. Our findings suggest that access to equipment and learning opportunities may increase the likelihood of farmers using straw as mulch instead of burning it. Specifically, social learning appears to increase the likelihood of farmers embracing no-burn practices relative to learning from extension agencies. Furthermore, the form of learning depends on farm size. While large and medium farmers exhibit a variety of learning strategies, small farmers primarily self-learn. These results underscore the importance of a multiprong policy that provides sufficient access to equipment and a combination of learning platforms that enabling farmers from different land classes to adopt no-burn technologies.
abstract_zh: 印度面临严峻的空气质量挑战，这既关乎当地健康，也涉及全球气候问题。尽管全国已禁止焚烧农业残留物，并实施了各种激励计划，印度北部的农民在遏制露天焚烧方面仍面临困难。利用印度旁遮普农村1021户农户的数据，我们考察了免烧农业采纳的模式与驱动因素，特别是针对那些将作物残茬覆盖还田而非焚烧的农民。我们发现，2015至2017年间，农民采用免烧耕作的趋势有所增长，其中大农户的采纳率最高，高于中等和小农户。我们的研究结果表明，获得设备和学习机会可能会提高农民将秸秆用作覆盖物而非焚烧的可能性。具体而言，相较于从推广机构学习，社会学习似乎更能提高农民采纳免烧做法的可能性。此外，学习的形式取决于农场规模。大农户和中等农户展现出多种学习策略，而小农户则主要依靠自学。这些结果强调了多管齐下的政策的重要性：既要为农民提供充足的设备获取途径，也要提供多样化的学习平台，使不同土地等级的农民都能够采纳免烧技术。

title: Social setting, gender, and preferences for improved sanitation: Evidence from experimental games in rural India
abstract: Unimproved sanitation and hygiene practices present a persistent threat to public health and well-being. Increasing the adoption of safe hygiene and sanitation requires both technological investments as well as behavioral change, suggesting that social contexts may be important in determining the success of efforts towards improved sanitation and hygiene. We examine how the social setting, particularly the gender balance of decision-making spaces, influences stated preferences for improving sanitation using a lab-in-the-field experiment. We designed a sanitation-themed public goods game in which participants made contributions that corresponded to varying levels of sanitation and hygiene investments. We implemented these games with over 1500 participants in 69 villages in rural Bihar and Odisha, India, randomly varying group gender composition (women only, men only, and mixed gender). Our study finds that individuals playing in single gender groups make larger contributions; these increases are driven by women playing in groups with only women. In mixed gender groups, contributions increase with the share of male participants and over rounds played. We also find that preferences elicited via experimental games are correlated with revealed preferences for hygiene and sanitation – game behavior and sanitation practices are positively correlated for men and negatively correlated for women. Collectively, our findings suggest that sanitation promotion programs, which rightfully focus on community mobilization, could be more effective if they explicitly incorporated gender preferences and considered the social decision-making environment in their design
abstract_zh: 不达标的卫生设施和卫生习惯对公众健康与福祉构成持续威胁。要提高安全卫生设施的采用率，既需要技术投资，也需要行为改变，这表明社会情境可能在改善卫生设施的努力能否成功方面发挥重要作用。我们利用田野实验室实验，考察社会情境——特别是决策空间中的性别构成——如何影响人们对改善卫生设施的陈述偏好。我们设计了一个以卫生设施为主题的公共物品博弈，参与者的捐献分别对应不同水平的卫生设施投资。我们在印度比哈尔邦和奥里萨邦的69个村庄中，对1500多名参与者开展了这些博弈，并随机改变小组的性别构成（仅女性、仅男性和男女混合）。我们的研究发现，在单一性别小组中博弈的个人捐献更多；这种增长主要由仅有女性的小组中的女性推动。在男女混合小组中，捐献随男性参与者比例的增加以及博弈轮次的推进而增加。我们还发现，通过实验博弈所获得的偏好，与卫生习惯的显示性偏好相关——对男性而言，博弈行为与卫生设施做法呈正相关，而对女性而言则呈负相关。总之，我们的研究结果表明，卫生设施推广项目（其重点在于社区动员，这一点无可厚非）如果在设计中明确纳入性别偏好，并考虑社会决策环境，可能会更加有效

title: Volumetric pricing in rural Central America: Drivers of adoption and potential effects on water delivery
abstract: In rural and peri-urban areas of Central America, community water organizations (CWOs) provide water to 60% of the population, thereby playing a pivotal role in achieving multiple Sustainable Development Goals. However, the underlying environmental, climatic, and institutional factors explaining the adoption of volumetric pricing from these water providers and its effect on service delivery are typically overlooked in the literature. In this paper, we address two issues. First, we test whether volumetric pricing affects the service water delivery in a rural setting, drawing on a random sample of cross-sectional data on 154 CWOs in Costa Rica, Guatemala, and Nicaragua. We find that volumetric pricing is associated with substantially more successful water delivery, even when conditioned on institutional capacity, environmental attributes, climatic conditions, and country-fixed effects. Despite this strong relationship, volumetric pricing has yet to be widely adopted, particularly in Nicaragua and Guatemala. Therefore, as the second goal, we try to identify the institutional and socio-ecological conditions in which volumetric pricing is adopted. We find that volumetric pricing is more likely used when communities (1) experience adverse environmental and climatic conditions associated with water scarcity and (2) have greater institutional capacity. Our results highlight the importance of examining the social-ecological system to assess the performance and adoption of water management institutions
abstract_zh: 在中美洲的农村和城郊地区，社区供水组织（CWO）为60%的人口提供用水，因此在实现多项可持续发展目标方面发挥着关键作用。然而，文献中通常忽视了解释这些供水机构采用按量计价（volumetric pricing）的潜在环境、气候和制度因素，以及其对服务供给的影响。在本文中，我们探讨两个问题。第一，我们利用来自哥斯达黎加、危地马拉和尼加拉瓜154个CWO的随机抽样横截面数据，检验按量计价是否影响农村地区的供水服务。我们发现，即使在控制了制度能力、环境特征、气候条件和国家固定效应之后，按量计价仍与显著更为成功的供水服务相关。尽管这一关系很强，按量计价仍未被广泛采用，尤其是在尼加拉瓜和危地马拉。因此，第二个目标是识别按量计价得以采用的制度与社会生态条件。我们发现，当社区（1）面临与缺水相关的不利环境和气候条件，且（2）拥有更强的制度能力时，更有可能采用按量计价。我们的结果凸显了考察社会生态系统的重要性，以评估水资源管理制度的绩效及其采用情况。

title: Frameworks, methods and evidence connecting modern domestic energy services and gender empowerment
abstract: The world remains far from meeting Sustainable Development Goals 5 (gender equality) and 7 (universal access to modern energy). Energy access may empower women even as empowered women are more likely to adopt and use modern energy services. Such bidirectional linkages are underappreciated in the empirical literature, which typically estimates unidirectional relationships based on simple binary indicators. Here we review theoretical frameworks on women’s empowerment, take stock of the empirical literature on the connections between women’s empowerment and energy access, and place empirical results in the context of the theoretical literature. We highlight major knowledge gaps that require further attention from researchers and practitioners. In particular, we recommend the use of more comprehensive measures of energy services, the consideration of a richer set of gender empowerment indicators and the application of pluralistic methods to address the challenges of understanding how energy intersects with gender.
abstract_zh: 世界距离实现可持续发展目标第5项（性别平等）和第7项（普遍获得现代能源）仍相去甚远。能源可及可能赋能女性，而拥有更多权能的女性也更可能采用和使用现代能源服务。这种双向联系在实证文献中未得到充分重视，实证研究通常基于简单的二元指标估计单向关系。在此，我们回顾了关于女性赋权的理论框架，梳理了关于女性赋权与能源可及之间联系的实证文献，并将实证结果置于理论文献的语境中加以考察。我们指出了需要研究者和实践者进一步关注的主要知识空白。特别是，我们建议使用更为全面的能源服务衡量指标、考虑更丰富的性别赋权指标集，并运用多元化方法，以应对理解能源与性别交织关系的挑战。

title: Gender empowerment and energy access: evidence from seven countries
abstract: Gender equity is connected to modern energy services in many ways, but quantitative empirical work on these connections is limited. We examine the relationship between a multi-dimensional measure of women’s empowerment and access to improved cookstoves, clean fuels, and electricity. We use the World Bank Multi-Tier Framework survey datasets from seven countries that include almost 25 000 households in Africa and Asia. First, we apply principal component analysis to construct a household level empowerment index, using data on women’s education, credit access, social capital, mobility, and employment. Then, we use simple regression analysis to study the correlation between empowerment and energy access at the household level. We find a positive association between the women’s empowerment index and energy access variables, though this household pattern does not hold across all countries and contexts. While we do not claim that these relationships are causal, to our knowledge this is a fresh analysis of how the empowerment of women is differentially correlated with household energy access across geographies and technologies. Thus, our analysis provides a first step to further work aimed at clarifying gender-energy linkages.
abstract_zh: 性别平等在许多方面与现代能源服务相关联，但关于这些联系的定量实证研究却十分有限。我们考察了女性赋权的多维度衡量指标与改良炉灶、清洁燃料和电力获取之间的关系。我们使用了世界银行多层级框架（MTF）调查数据集，涵盖非洲和亚洲七个国家近25,000户家庭。首先，我们运用主成分分析，利用女性受教育程度、信贷获取、社会资本、流动性和就业等数据，构建了家庭层面的赋权指数。随后，我们运用简单回归分析，考察家庭层面赋权与能源可及之间的相关性。我们发现，女性赋权指数与能源可及变量之间存在正向关联，尽管这一家庭层面的模式并非在所有国家和情境中都成立。虽然我们并不主张这些关系是因果的，但据我们所知，这是首次对女性赋权如何在不同地理区域和技术之间与家庭能源可及存在差异性关联所作的全新分析。因此，我们的分析为进一步阐明性别与能源联系的研究提供了第一步。

title: Introduction to the SETI special issue
Air quality valuation using online surveys in three Asian megacities
abstract: Due to worsening air quality across many cities in developing countries, there is an urgent need to consider more aggressive air pollution control measures. Valuation of the benefits of clean air is crucial for establishing the rationale for such policies, but is methodologically challenging, often expensive, and therefore remains limited. This study assesses the potential for more standardized and cost-effective measurement of the demand for air quality improvements, applying a contingent valuation procedure via online surveys, in three Asian megacities facing severe but varying pollution problems — Beijing, Delhi, and Jakarta. The study’s primary contribution is to demonstrate the viability of this approach, which significantly enhances comparability of valuations and their drivers across locations, and thereby has great potential for informing policy analysis and targeting of specific interventions. A second contribution is to supply sorely needed data on the benefits of clean air in these three particular Asian cities, which collectively have a population of about 50 million people. The annual willingness-to-pay for air quality to reach national standards is estimated to be US$150 in Jakarta (where average PM2.5 concentration, at 45 μg/m3, exceeds national standards by the smallest amount, specifically a factor of 1.3), US$1845 in Beijing (PM2.5 at 58 μg/m3, 1.7 times the standard), and US$1760 in Delhi (PM2.5 at 133 μg/m3, 3.3 times the standard). The methods deployed could be applied more widely to construct a worldwide database of comparable air quality valuations.
abstract_zh: 由于许多发展中国家城市的空气质量持续恶化，迫切需要考虑采取更为积极的空气污染控制措施。对清洁空气效益进行估值，是为此类政策提供依据的关键，但其方法具有挑战性、成本往往高昂，因此相关研究仍然有限。本研究评估了通过在线调查、采用条件价值评估程序，对空气质量改善需求进行更为标准化且具有成本效益的测量的潜力。研究在三个面临严重但程度各异的污染问题的亚洲特大城市——北京、德里和雅加达——开展。本研究的主要贡献在于证明了这一方法的可行性，它显著提高了不同地点估值及其驱动因素之间的可比性，因而在为政策分析和特定干预措施的瞄准提供信息方面具有巨大潜力。第二个贡献在于，为这三个亚洲城市的清洁空气效益提供了亟需的数据，这三个城市的人口合计约5000万。使空气质量达到国家标准的年度支付意愿估计值为：雅加达150美元（该市PM2.5平均浓度为45 μg/m³，超出国家标准的倍数最小，仅为1.3倍）；北京1845美元（PM2.5为58 μg/m³，为标准的1.7倍）；德里1760美元（PM2.5为133 μg/m³，为标准的3.3倍）。所采用的方法可以更广泛地应用，以构建一个可比的全球空气质量估值数据库。

title: COVID-19, public health messaging, and sanitation and hygiene practices in rural India
venue: Journal of Water Sanitation and Hygiene for Development
abstract: Despite the importance of safe sanitation and hygiene for sustainable development and public health, approximately half of India's rural population lacks access to safely managed sanitation. Policies prioritizing improved sanitation access have accelerated coverage, yet barriers to universal access and use remain. In this paper, we investigate how personal experience with a public health shock impacts recall of public health messages and households' sanitation and hygiene practices. Using a panel survey conducted before and after the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic, and the resulting lockdown, in Bihar, India, we compare public health messaging recall and hygiene and sanitation behaviors among households that experienced severe economic disruptions due to the COVID-19 lockdown and those that did not. We find that households that experienced economic disruptions had a higher recall of public health messaging around safe sanitation and hygiene. In addition, households that experienced these disruptions reported more social distancing, increased handwashing behavior, and reduced open defecation. A major public health shock, the COVID-19 pandemic, increased messaging around the importance of safe hygiene and sanitation for public health in India. We find that personal experience increased the salience of public health messaging, with positive returns to sanitation and hygiene practices.
abstract_zh: 尽管安全卫生设施和卫生习惯对可持续发展和公共健康至关重要，但印度约一半的农村人口仍无法获得安全管理的卫生设施。优先改善卫生设施可及性的政策加快了覆盖率的提高，但普遍获得和使用卫生设施的障碍依然存在。在本文中，我们考察了个人经历公共卫生冲击如何影响其对公共卫生信息的回忆，以及家庭的卫生设施和卫生习惯。利用在印度比哈尔邦COVID-19大流行第一波及随之而来的封锁前后开展的追踪调查面板数据，我们比较了因封锁而遭受严重经济冲击的家庭与未遭受此类冲击的家庭，在公共卫生信息回忆以及卫生和卫生设施行为方面的差异。我们发现，经历经济冲击的家庭对安全卫生设施相关公共卫生信息的回忆率更高。此外，经历这些冲击的家庭报告了更多的社交距离、更多的洗手行为，以及更少的露天排便。一次重大的公共卫生冲击——COVID-19大流行——增强了印度关于安全卫生设施与公共健康重要性的宣传。我们发现，个人经历提高了公共卫生信息的显著性，并带来了卫生设施和卫生习惯方面的正向回报。

title: Effect of electricity price reform on households’ electricity consumption in urban Ethiopia
abstract: This paper studies the effect of the revised tariff on households’ electricity consumption in Ethiopia using two rounds of household survey data. The study finds that pre-paid customers reduce their consumption of electricity equivalent to 8% of their monthly electricity expenditure and around 14% of their daily consumption, in the post tariff adjustment periods. The findings indicate that governments and utilities in settings where electricity is priced well below cost-covering levels may be able to increase revenues and improve their balance sheets with relatively modest effects on households’ electricity consumption, though effects from more substantial tariff hikes should be examined.
abstract_zh: 本文利用两轮家庭调查数据，研究了修订后的电价对埃塞俄比亚家庭用电量的影响。研究发现，在电价调整后的时期，预付费用户的用电量减少了相当于其月度电费支出8%的部分，以及其日用电量约14%的部分。研究结果表明，在电价远低于成本回收水平的地区，政府和公用事业公司或许能够在对家庭用电量影响相对温和的情况下增加收入、改善其资产负债状况，但更大幅度的电价上调所产生的影响仍有待检验。

title: Pre-paid meters and household electricity use behaviors: Evidence from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
abstract: In low-income countries such as Ethiopia, pre-paid metering is often argued to alleviate several challenges with traditional electricity billing systems, including high non-payment rate, pilferage and fraud, administrative and enforcement costs for utilities, and inflexibility and incongruence of bills with poorer consumers' irregular income. Despite increasing adoption of this technology, few studies examine its causal impacts on household behaviour. This paper examines the impacts of pre-paid metering on electricity consumption, ownership of appliances, level of satisfaction, and cooking behaviour in Addis Ababa, the capital of Ethiopia. We employ propensity score matching and instrumental variable techniques to control for the non-random selection into pre-paid metering. Results indicate that pre-paid customers have significantly lower electricity consumption compared to those with traditional meters, and express greater satisfaction with utility service. This technology also has a positive, but modest and statistically insignificant impact on total appliance ownership, and a positive and significant impact on ownership of energy-efficient lights. Impacts are heterogeneous across customers, however: those who are more educated, who have higher income, and who do not share meters tend to reduce electricity use more. The results suggest that pre-paid meters have had positive impacts on households and the utility in Addis Ababa.
abstract_zh: 在埃塞俄比亚等低收入国家，预付费电表常被认为能够缓解传统电费计费系统所面临的若干挑战，包括拖欠率高、窃电和欺诈、公用事业公司的行政与执法成本，以及账单缺乏灵活性且与贫困消费者不规律的收入不相匹配。尽管这一技术的采用日益增多，但很少有研究考察其对家庭行为的因果影响。本文考察了预付费电表对埃塞俄比亚首都亚的斯亚贝巴的用电量、家电拥有情况、满意度和烹饪行为的影响。我们运用倾向得分匹配和工具变量技术，以控制预付费电表的非随机选择问题。结果表明，与使用传统电表的用户相比，预付费用户的用电量显著更低，并且对公用事业服务表现出更高的满意度。该技术对家电总拥有量具有正向但幅度温和且统计上不显著的影响，而对节能灯具的拥有量则具有正向且显著的影响。然而，影响因客户而异：受教育程度较高、收入较高且不与他人共用电表的用户，往往会减少更多的用电量。结果表明，预付费电表对亚的斯亚贝巴的家庭和公用事业公司均产生了正向影响。

title: Space matters: reducing energy disparity in Nepal through spatially equitable renewable energy subsidies
abstract: Affordability is a major barrier to the adoption of clean energy technologies in low-income countries, which is partly why many governments provide subsidies to offset some of the upfront (installation) costs. However, simple administrative rules might not fully account for economic geography, resulting in lower subsidies for remote areas. Using regression analysis on a rich dataset of adoption, cost and subsidy for about 4000 Nepalese Village Development Committees over 22 years, we show that administratively determined lumpsum subsidies disproportionately hurt remote communities. Simulations show that adjusting the subsidy spatially to reflect the geographic cost of living, can increase clean technology adoption. Thus, spatial targeting of subsidies is key to accelerating energy access in remote settings such as the Hindu Kush Himalaya.
abstract_zh: 负担能力是低收入国家采用清洁能源技术的主要障碍，这也是许多政府提供补贴以抵消部分前期（安装）成本的部分原因。然而，简单的行政规则可能无法充分考虑经济地理因素，导致偏远地区获得的补贴较低。我们利用约4000个尼泊尔村发展委员会在22年间的采用、成本与补贴数据丰富的数据集，进行回归分析后发现，行政确定的一次性补贴不成比例地损害了偏远社区。模拟结果表明，根据地理生活成本空间性地调整补贴，可以提高清洁技术的采用率。因此，补贴的空间瞄准是加速兴都库什—喜马拉雅等偏远地区能源可及的关键。

title: Speaking from experience: Preferences for cooking with biogas in rural India
abstract: Biogas has the potential to satisfy the clean energy needs of millions of households in under-served and energy-poor rural areas, while reducing both private and social costs linked to (i) fuels for household cooking, (ii) fertilizers, (iii) pressure on forests, and (iv) emissions (e.g., PM2.5 and methane) that damage both household health and global climate. While the literature has focused on identifying these costs, less attention has been paid to household preferences for biogas systems — specifically what attributes are popular with which types of households. We conduct a discrete choice experiment with 503 households in rural Odisha, India, to better characterize preferences for different attributes (smoke reduction, fuel efficiency, and maintenance) and for different cooking technologies (biogas and an improved biomass cookstove). We find that on average households value smoke reduction and fuel efficiency. Willingness to pay (WTP) a premium for the improved biomass cookstove is low, while willingness to pay a premium for biogas is high. Nonetheless, WTP varies by the type of previous experience with biogas (e.g., good or bad experience) and with time and risk preferences of households. While risk-averse and impatient respondents have lower WTP for the improved cookstoves, previous experience with biogas attenuates this gap. These findings suggest that biogas uptake and diffusion could be improved by complementing existing subsidies with technology trials, good quality products, maintenance, and customer services to reduce uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 沼气有潜力满足欠发达和能源贫困农村地区数百万家庭的清洁能源需求，同时减少与以下方面相关的私人和社会成本：（i）家庭烹饪燃料、（ii）化肥、（iii）森林压力，以及（iv）损害家庭健康和全球气候的排放（例如PM2.5和甲烷）。尽管文献侧重于识别这些成本，但对家庭对沼气系统偏好的研究较少，尤其是哪些属性受到哪类家庭的青睐。我们在印度奥里萨邦农村对503户家庭进行了离散选择实验，以更好地刻画其对不同属性（减少烟雾、燃料效率和维护）以及不同烹饪技术（沼气和改良生物质炉灶）的偏好。我们发现，平均而言，家庭重视减少烟雾和燃料效率。对改良生物质炉灶的溢价支付意愿较低，而对沼气的溢价支付意愿较高。尽管如此，支付意愿因家庭先前使用沼气的经历类型（例如良好或不良体验）以及家庭的时间偏好和风险偏好而异。虽然厌恶风险和缺乏耐心的受访者对改良炉灶的支付意愿较低，但先前使用沼气的经历减弱了这一差距。这些发现表明，若在现有补贴之外，辅以技术试用、优质产品、维护和客户服务以减少不确定性，沼气的采用与推广可以得到改善。

title: Sustaining latrine use: Peers, policies, and sanitation behaviors
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: One third of the world's population lacks access to improved sanitation facilities with ramifications for health, human well-being, and economic development. Although household latrines offer a relatively cheap technological solution, initiatives for universal coverage have fallen short of their goals. In this paper, we analyze a unique panel dataset to examine policies and peer effects as drivers of household sanitation behaviors over time. Our data include nearly 1000 rural Indian households across 39 villages surveyed at five time points over a 14-year period during which two distinct sanitation policy interventions occurred. Using spatial data on household locations to define peer reference groups, we estimate how the sanitation behaviors of neighbors influence latrine use, both at the household level and by gender. We find evidence that, while external interventions can be effective in increasing latrine use in the short term, sustained household latrine use consistently depends on neighbors’ behavior. We also examine within- and across-group peer influences by examining patterns of latrine use among adult women and men. We find clear evidence that latrine use by neighboring women positively influences sanitation behaviors for both women and men, while latrine use among neighboring men has imprecisely estimated and small positive effects on men's behaviors and no effect on women's behaviors. These finding suggest that peer influences represent an important mechanism underlying household sanitation behavior, and policies that leverage these social effects, such as investments expanding women's access to sanitation and other drivers of behavior change, may be more effective and sustainable.
abstract_zh: 全球三分之一的人口无法获得改善的卫生设施，这对健康、人类福祉和经济发展都产生了影响。尽管家用厕所提供了一种相对廉价的技术解决方案，但实现普遍覆盖的举措未能达到预期目标。在本文中，我们利用一个独特的面板数据集，考察政策与同伴效应如何随时间推动家庭的卫生行为。我们的数据包括印度农村约1000户家庭，他们分布在39个村庄，在一段14年的时间里经过五个时间点的调查，期间发生了两次不同的卫生政策干预。我们利用家庭位置的空间数据定义同伴参照群体，估计邻居的卫生行为如何影响家庭层面以及按性别划分的厕所使用情况。我们发现，外部干预在短期内能有效提高厕所使用率，但持续的家庭厕所使用始终取决于邻居的行为。我们还通过考察成年女性和男性的厕所使用模式，检验了组内与跨组的同伴影响。我们发现明确的证据表明，邻近女性的厕所使用对女性和男性的卫生行为均具有正向影响；而邻近男性的厕所使用对男性行为具有估计不精确且较小的正向效应，对女性行为则无影响。这些发现表明，同伴影响是家庭卫生行为背后的一个重要机制，而利用这些社会效应的政策——例如扩大女性获得卫生设施的渠道以及其他行为改变的驱动因素的投资——可能会更为有效且更具可持续性。

title: A ‘middle way’ for Indonesian fires
Do Decentralized Community Treatment Plants Provide Clean Water? Evidence from Rural Andhra Pradesh, India AMI
abstract: Though there is little evidence on its effectiveness, a decentralized community water system (CWS), such as a market-based kiosk, is thought to be appropriate where piped services are infeasible or unreliable. We assess changes in household behaviors, water quality, and health following the installation of a CWS in rural India, using quasi-experimental methods. Three negative findings stand out: (1) few households use the CWS, (2) water quality is lower among CWS users, and (3) childhood diarrhea is higher among CWS users. This appears to stem from reduced self-protection by users amid continuing reliance on multiple water sources. Decentralized supply solutions will not deliver environmental quality unless household protective behaviors are maintained.
abstract_zh: 尽管关于其有效性的证据很少，但在无法铺设管道或管道服务不可行或不可靠的地方，去中心化的社区供水系统（CWS），例如基于市场的供水亭，被认为是适宜的。我们利用准实验方法，评估了印度农村安装CWS后家庭行为、水质和健康状况的变化。有三项负面发现尤为突出：（1）很少有家庭使用CWS；（2）CWS用户的水质更差；（3）CWS用户的儿童腹泻发病率更高。这似乎源于用户在继续依赖多种水源的情况下，自我防护有所减少。除非家庭的防护行为得以维持，否则去中心化的供水解决方案将无法带来环境质量的改善。

title: Do improved cookstoves save time and improve gender outcomes? Evidence from six developing countries
abstract: Three billion people around the world lack access to affordable and reliable clean cooking energy. The case for clean energy has largely been built around health and or environmental benefits, neglecting potentially sizeable benefit(s): when households have clean energy, they can save time and reduce drudgery. Clean energy can reduce poverty. But how large are time savings from the adoption and use of improved cookstoves (ICS)? Do these benefits accrue especially to women? To answer these questions, we develop a conceptual framework based on household production, and then employ two complementary empirical methods. First, we review the impact evaluation literature that estimates time savings from use of various ICS. Second, we conduct multivariable regression analysis of Multi-Tier Framework (MTF) data from six countries to estimate the impacts of ICS on time spent on cooking. The review and econometric estimation offer consistent evidence that ICS can help households save time, but the estimated savings vary across locations, technologies, and study methods. Time savings (i) are consistent across both rural and urban areas, (ii) are greatest for fuel collection and preparation (rather than cooking), (iii) accrue to both women and men, and (iv) are highest for more advanced technologies and fuels (like electricity, LPG, and biogas). Overall, our pooled econometric estimates suggest that ICS use leads households to save about 34 min per day. Our estimate is lower than the average of estimates in the literature (68 min/day), but not so different from the average among a lower cluster of estimates (29 min/day). While our work illuminates shortcomings inherent in current research on this topic, our results constitute an important first step towards advancing the practice of quantification of time savings from household energy interventions.
abstract_zh: 全世界有三十亿人无法获得负担得起且可靠的清洁烹饪能源。清洁能源的论证在很大程度上是围绕健康和/或环境效益构建的，而忽视了可能相当可观的其他效益：当家庭拥有清洁能源时，可以节省时间、减轻繁重的家务劳动。清洁能源能够减少贫困。但是，采用和使用改良炉灶（ICS）所节省的时间有多大？这些效益是否尤其惠及女性？为回答这些问题，我们基于家庭生产理论构建了一个概念框架，然后采用两种互补的实证方法。第一，我们回顾了估计使用各种ICS所节省时间的影响评估文献。第二，我们对来自六个国家的多层级框架（MTF）数据进行了多变量回归分析，以估计ICS对烹饪时间的影响。综述与计量估计均一致表明，ICS能够帮助家庭节省时间，但估计的节省量因地点、技术和研究方法而异。时间节省（i）在农村和城市地区都一致存在，（ii）在燃料收集与准备（而非烹饪本身）方面最为显著，（iii）对女性和男性均有益，并且（iv）在更先进的技术和燃料（如电力、液化石油气和沼气）下最高。总体而言，我们的汇总计量估计表明，使用ICS可使家庭每天节省约34分钟。我们的估计低于文献中估计值的平均水平（每天68分钟），但与较低一组估计值的平均水平（每天29分钟）相差不大。尽管我们的工作揭示了当前该主题研究中固有的不足，但我们的结果构成了推进家庭能源干预时间节省量化实践的重要第一步。

title: Households' valuation of power outages in major cities of Ethiopia: An application of stated preference methods
abstract: In many developing countries, electricity consumers experience frequent supply interruptions, leading to high coping costs and stifled investment, which contribute to energy poverty. In 2019, we implemented stated preference experiments to estimate households' preferences for improved electricity supply in a nationally representative sample of urban households, covering 42 cities in Ethiopia. In the first split-sample experiment, we presented respondents with a contingent valuation (CV) scenario that alternatively elicited their willingness to pay (WTP) for reduced evening-time power outages, or their willingness to accept (WTA) compensation for increased disruptions. Then, we implemented a discrete choice experiment with the same respondents to understand preferences for the frequency, duration and time of a day attributes of outages, as well as the value of advanced notification. The results from the CV survey show that household WTP is approximately 40 birr (US$1.4) for a three-hour reduction of duration in power outages in the evening and that WTA is 42 birr (US$1.4) for a similar increase in the duration of outages during that period. The choice experiment meanwhile reveals that household WTP is 11 birr (US$0.4) for a one-unit reduction in the number of outages and 53 birr (US$1.8) to avoid daytime or nighttime outages relative to morning outages, on average. Households prefer a day prior outage notification to a week prior notification, with a marginal WTP of 23 birr (US$0.8). Information about the value of such outage attributes can help inform strategies that better address electricity consumers' preferences and needs. We finally discussed the relationship between energy poverty and preferences for improved electricity supply.
abstract_zh: 在许多发展中国家，电力消费者经常遭遇频繁的供电中断，这导致了高昂的应对成本并抑制了投资，进而加剧了能源贫困。2019年，我们开展了陈述偏好实验，以估计埃塞俄比亚42个城市中具有全国代表性的城市家庭样本，对改善供电的偏好。在第一个分样本实验中，我们向受访者呈现了一个条件价值评估（CV）情景，分别引出他们对减少晚间停电的支付意愿（WTP），或对增加此类停电干扰的受偿意愿（WTA）。随后，我们对同一批受访者开展了一项离散选择实验，以了解他们对停电频率、时长和一天中的时段等属性的偏好，以及提前通知的价值。CV调查结果显示，对于晚间停电时长减少三小时，家庭的支付意愿约为40比尔（1.4美元）；而对于该时段停电时长增加相似幅度，其受偿意愿为42比尔（1.4美元）。离散选择实验则显示，平均而言，停电次数每减少一次，家庭的支付意愿为11比尔（0.4美元）；相对于早晨停电，避免白天或夜间停电的支付意愿为53比尔（1.8美元）。相比提前一周通知，家庭更偏好提前一天通知，其边际支付意愿为23比尔（0.8美元）。关于这些停电属性价值的信息，有助于制定更好地满足电力消费者偏好和需求的策略。最后，我们讨论了能源贫困与改善供电偏好之间的关系。

title: Is energy the golden thread? A systematic review of the impacts of modern and traditional energy use in low- and middle-income countries
abstract: Energy has been called the “golden thread” that connects economic growth, social equity and environmental sustainability, but important knowledge gaps exist on the impacts of low- and middle-income country energy interventions and transitions. This study offers perhaps the broadest characterization to date of the patterns and consistency in quantitative and peer-reviewed social science literature considering such impacts. Starting from approximately 80,000 papers identified using a search procedure organized along energy services, technology, and impact dimensions, and structured to achieve breadth and replicability, articles were first screened to yield a relevant subset of 3,000 quantitative papers. Relevance is defined as providing one or more types of impacts on intra-household, household, firm, public service, national economy, or environmental outcomes. A set of heat maps highlights areas of concentration in the literature, namely work that emphasizes the negative health and pollution effects of traditional cooking and fossil fuel use. The extent and consistency of evidence for different types of impacts (in terms of direction and statistical significance) is also discussed, which reveals considerable heterogeneity and highlights important knowledge gaps that remain despite rapidly expanding energy scholarship. The patterns of evidence are also surprisingly consistent across methods. The article concludes by articulating several research challenges that should motivate current and future generations of energy and development scholars.
abstract_zh: 能源被称为连接经济增长、社会公平与环境可持续性的“金线”，但关于低收入和中等收入国家能源干预与转型影响的重要知识空白依然存在。本研究对定量的、经同行评议的社会科学文献中这些影响的模式与一致性进行了或许是迄今最为广泛的刻画。研究从约80,000篇论文出发（检索程序按能源服务、技术和影响维度组织，力求兼顾广度与可复制性），先筛选出3,000篇相关的定量研究论文。相关性定义为：论文考察了家庭内部、家庭、企业、公共服务、国民经济或环境结果中的一种或多种影响。一组热力图突出了文献的集中领域，即强调传统烹饪和化石燃料使用对健康与污染负面影响的研究。本文还讨论了不同类型影响证据的范围与一致性（就方向和统计显著性而言），结果显示出相当大的异质性，并凸显了尽管能源研究迅速扩张，仍然存在的重要知识空白。不同方法下的证据模式也出人意料地一致。文章最后提出了若干研究挑战，以期激励当前及未来各代能源与发展领域的学者。

title: The effectiveness of protected areas in the context of decentralization
abstract: While protected areas (PA) remain a key conservation strategy globally, their performance is likely shaped by the socio-political context in which they exist. Although decentralization is a good example of such a contextual phenomenon in multiple locations globally, it is rare to find quantitative empirical analyses of how it moderates PA effectiveness. We evaluate how the decentralization in Indonesia (proxied by the introduction of direct elections, district head (bupati) change, and district splitting) influenced PA effectiveness between 2000 and 2008. Focusing on three outcomes - deforestation, forest fragmentation, and fires, we apply a quasi-experimental approach to a carefully constructed spatially explicit village-level panel dataset, combined with geospatial biophysical and physio-geographic data. We hypothesize that the moderating influence of decentralization on PA effectiveness depends on whether decentralization increased threats to forests, strengthened local accountability, or weakened enforcement. On average, we find direct elections improved the PA impact in terms of reducing deforestation in protected villages, but had no statistically significant effect on forest fragmentation, fires, or leakage. On average, we find district splitting increased forest fragmentation in the recently protected villages, but had no statistically significant impact on deforestation and fires. On average, we find the bupati change had no statistically discernible influence on PA impacts on deforestation, fragmentation or fires. Given the increasing threats to forests due to decentralization, these results imply that district splitting and the bupati change weakened enforcement inside PAs with regards to deforestation and forest fragmentation, in contrast to direct elections. By highlighting the potential channels through which decentralization in Indonesia impacted forests, we offer insights into the effectiveness of a common conservation policy in the country. Broadly, we contribute to the conservation impact evaluation literature by quantitatively examining how political economy influences the performance of conservation policies.
abstract_zh: 尽管保护区（PA）仍是全球主要的保护策略，但其成效很可能受到其所处社会政治背景的影响。分权是全球多地普遍存在的此类情境性现象之一，然而，很少有定量实证分析考察分权如何调节保护区的成效。我们评估了印度尼西亚的分权（以直接选举的引入、县长（bupati）更替以及县的分立作为代理变量）在2000至2008年间如何影响保护区成效。我们聚焦于三项结果——森林砍伐、森林破碎化和火灾，采用准实验方法，结合一个精心构建的、空间明确的村庄级面板数据集，以及地理空间生物物理和自然地理数据。我们假设，分权对保护区成效的调节作用取决于分权是否加剧了对森林的威胁、增强了地方问责，还是削弱了执法。平均而言，我们发现直接选举改善了保护村庄中减少森林砍伐的保护区效果，但对森林破碎化、火灾或泄漏没有统计上显著的影响。平均而言，我们发现县的分立增加了新近受保护村庄的森林破碎化，但对森林砍伐和火灾没有统计上显著的影响。平均而言，我们发现县长更替对保护区在森林砍伐、破碎化或火灾方面的影响没有统计上可辨别的作用。鉴于分权带来的森林威胁日益增加，这些结果表明，与直接选举相反，县的分立和县长更替削弱了保护区内关于森林砍伐和森林破碎化的执法。通过揭示印度尼西亚分权影响森林的潜在渠道，我们为该国一项常见保护政策的成效提供了见解。总体而言，我们通过定量考察政治经济学如何影响保护政策的绩效，为保护影响评估文献作出了贡献。

title: The enabling environment for household solar adoption: A systematic review
abstract: The sheer scope of the global energy poverty challenge has motivated many organizations to promote off-grid solar energy for lighting, heating, and cooking needs around the world. However, the design and implementation of projects depends on the enabling environment - a constellation of financial, market, program, and regulatory factors. We conducted a systematic review to examine which elements of the enabling environment drove or blocked the adoption of solar products such as, home systems, lanterns, hot water heaters, and cooking products in low- and middle- income countries (LMICs). Specifically, we identified 59 studies in 29 countries that consider different features of the enabling environment and found the following empirical regularities. First, at the household level, cost, therefore subsidies, and product quality matter. Second, at the program level, customer support and ongoing maintenance influence sustained use. Third, at the government scale, design standards and regulations affect adoption. However, clear gaps emerge in what scholars have studied; for example, we found no empirical literature on e-wastes or demand by energy-access tiers. Nonetheless, the experiences documented in this review show that a complex and interconnected system of market, program, financial, and regulatory challenges must be addressed to provide solar technologies to the rural energy poor.
abstract_zh: 全球能源贫困挑战之严峻，促使许多组织在世界各地推广用于照明、取暖和烹饪需求的离网太阳能。然而，项目的设计与实施取决于其所处的支持性环境——即金融、市场、项目和监管因素的综合体。我们开展了一项系统综述，考察支持性环境中哪些要素推动或阻碍了太阳能产品（如家用系统、灯具、热水器和炊事产品）在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的采用。具体而言，我们识别出29个国家的59项研究，这些研究考察了支持性环境的不同特征，并发现了以下经验规律。第一，在家庭层面，成本（因而补贴）和产品质量至关重要。第二，在项目层面，客户支持和持续维护影响持续使用。第三，在政府层面，设计标准和法规影响采用。然而，学界的研究仍存在明显空白；例如，我们没有发现关于电子废弃物或按能源可及性层级划分的需求的实证文献。尽管如此，本综述所记录的经验表明，必须应对市场、项目、金融和监管方面相互关联、错综复杂的挑战，才能为农村能源贫困人口提供太阳能技术。

title: Time-varying pricing may increase total electricity consumption: Evidence from Costa Rica
abstract: We study the implementation of a time-varying pricing (TVP) program by a major electricity utility in Costa Rica. Because of particular features of the data, we use recently developed understanding of the two-way fixed effects differences-in-differences estimator along with event-study specifications to interpret our results. Similar to previous research, we find that the program reduces consumption during peak-hours. However, in contrast with previous research, we find that the program increases total consumption. With a stylized economic model, we show how these seemingly conflicted results may not be at odds. The key element of the model is that previous research used data from rich countries, in which the use of heating and cooling devices drives electricity consumption, but we use data from a tropical middle-income country, where very few households have heating or cooling devices. Since there is not much room for technological changes (which might reduce consumption at all times), behavioral changes to reduce consumption during peak hours are not enough to offset the increased consumption during off-peak hours (when electricity is cheaper). Our results serve as a cautionary piece of evidence for policy makers interested in reducing consumption during peak hours—the goal can potentially be achieved with TVP, but the cost is increased total consumption
abstract_zh: 我们研究了哥斯达黎加一家大型电力公司实施分时电价（TVP）计划的情况。由于数据的特殊性，我们运用近期发展起来的双向固定效应双重差分估计量，并结合事件研究设定来解释结果。与以往研究类似，我们发现该计划降低了高峰时段的用电量。然而，与以往研究相反，我们发现该计划增加了总用电量。借助一个简化的经济模型，我们说明了这些看似相互矛盾的结果其实可以并不冲突。该模型的关键在于：以往研究使用的是富裕国家的数据，那里的电力消费由取暖和制冷设备驱动；而我们使用的是一个热带中等收入国家的数据，那里很少有家庭拥有取暖或制冷设备。由于技术变革的空间有限（技术变革可能在任何时段都减少用电），高峰时段为减少用电而进行的行为调整不足以抵消非高峰时段（电价较便宜时）用电量的增加。我们的结果为希望减少高峰时段用电量的政策制定者提供了一个警示性证据——这一目标可能通过分时电价实现，但代价是总用电量的增加。

title: Willingness to pay to avoid flooding in Cuttack, India
venue: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction
abstract: Flooding is a frequent natural disaster, which is predicted to intensify over time because of climate change. As more than half the world lives in urban spaces, flooding could devastate urban populations, especially if the infrastructure to cope with flooding is inadequate. We study flooding in Cuttack, Odisha, a typical Indian city subject to annual flooding. We present estimates from a lower and lower-middle income country of household willingness to pay (WTP) for improved urban drainage using a revealed preference method. We use a hedonic price model to estimate WTP across city zones with differential exposure to flooding. At 2014–15 prices, a typical flood (approximately 7 hours per day on average) reduces the annual rental value by INR1352 (US$ 21) or about 4.4% annually. This implies that Cuttack households are willing to pay INR 188 million (or $ 2.9 million) to avoid flooding. Our findings have implications for urban sustainability and the financing of public infrastructure to reduce flooding in low and lower-middle-income countries.
abstract_zh: 洪涝是一种频繁发生的自然灾害，由于气候变化，预计其强度会随时间增加。由于世界上超过半数人口生活在城市空间中，洪涝可能会给城市人口带来毁灭性影响，尤其是在应对洪涝的基础设施不足的情况下。我们研究了印度奥里萨邦库塔克（Cuttack）的洪涝问题，这是一个典型的、每年都遭受洪涝的印度城市。我们采用显示性偏好方法，给出了一个低收入和中低收入国家家庭为改善城市排水而支付意愿（WTP）的估计。我们使用特征价格模型（hedonic price model）估计不同洪涝暴露程度城区的支付意愿。按2014–15年价格计算，一次典型洪涝（平均每天约7小时）使年租金价值减少1352卢比（21美元），约占年租金的4.4%。这意味着库塔克的家庭愿意支付1.88亿卢比（或290万美元）以避免洪涝。我们的研究结果对低收入和中低收入国家的城市可持续性以及降低洪涝的公共基础设施融资具有启示意义。

title: Adoption and impacts of improved biomass cookstoves in rural Rajasthan
abstract: Biomass-burning improved cookstoves (ICS) are often seen as a promising intermediate technology solution along the path of household transition to cleaner cooking. This study reports on the results of an experimental evaluation of a carbon finance-enabled program conducted in rural villages in Rajasthan, India. Half (or 20) of 40 purposively-selected treatment villages were randomly assigned to an ‘early’ intervention group that was offered a package of two biomass fuel ICS one year prior to the other half (the ‘late’ group). Analysis of data collected prior to the second phase of the intervention shows that adoption of ICS reached nearly 46% in the group exposed to the intervention, and that households largely held positive short-term views of the effects of these technologies. Moreover, we found evidence of both time savings and reductions in fuel use among intervention households. Consistent with the wider literature on the limitations of biomass-burning ICS, however, we failed to detect consistent effects on self-reported respiratory health. Findings were generally consistent across simple and difference-in-difference estimates of impacts, and suggest that biomass-burning ICS can deliver benefits even when they offer few improvements in health.
abstract_zh: 生物质燃烧型改良炉灶（ICS）常被视为家庭向更清洁烹饪转型过程中一种有前景的中间技术方案。本研究报告了对印度拉贾斯坦邦农村村庄中一个由碳金融支持的项目进行实验评估的结果。在40个经有目的地选取的处理村庄中，一半（即20个）被随机分配到“早期”干预组，该组比另一半（“晚期”组）提前一年获得一套两台生物质燃料改良炉灶。对第二阶段干预前收集的数据分析显示，在接受干预的群体中，改良炉灶的采用率达到近46%，并且家庭对这些技术的短期效果总体持积极看法。此外，我们发现干预家庭节省了时间，并减少了燃料使用。然而，与生物质燃烧改良炉灶有限性的更广泛文献一致，我们未能检测到对自我报告呼吸系统健康的稳定影响。无论是简单估计还是双重差分估计，结果总体一致，并表明即使生物质燃烧改良炉灶在健康改善方面作用有限，仍可带来益处。

title: Improved sanitation increases long-term cognitive test scores
abstract: Poor sanitation has large negative impacts on environmental quality, health, and well-being. Sanitation infrastructure is particularly lacking in India, where in 2011, 66% of households did not own a toilet. Inadequate sanitation is a large contributor to diarrheal-related diseases, which cause 300,000 deaths in Indian children each year. We exploit an experimental sanitation campaign in rural Odisha, India to examine the relationship between sanitation improvements in early childhood and long-term cognitive development. We build on literature linking child health improvements to cognitive development and labor market outcomes and show that improvements in sanitation coverage can have large human capital returns. Using treatment assignment as an instrument for village latrine coverage, we find that children who belonged to a village with higher latrine coverage scored significantly higher on a cognitive test measuring analytic ability ten years later. We find that this effect is much stronger among girls than boys.
abstract_zh: 恶劣的卫生条件对环境质量、健康和福祉造成了巨大的负面影响。印度的卫生基础设施尤为匮乏，2011年有66%的家庭没有厕所。卫生设施不足是导致腹泻相关疾病的重要原因，每年在印度导致30万名儿童死亡。我们利用印度奥里萨邦农村地区一项实验性卫生运动，考察幼儿时期卫生条件改善与长期认知发展之间的关系。我们借鉴了将儿童健康改善与认知发展和劳动力市场结果联系起来的文献，并表明卫生覆盖率的提高可以带来巨大的人力资本回报。以处理分配作为村庄厕所覆盖率的工具变量，我们发现，所在村庄厕所覆盖率较高的儿童，十年后在一项衡量分析能力的认知测试中得分显著更高。我们发现，这一效应在女孩中远比男孩中强烈。

title: Making incremental progress: Impacts of a REDD+ pilot initiative in Nepal
abstract: Reducing emissions from deforestation and forest degradation (REDD+) encompasses a range of incentives for developing countries to slow, halt and reverse forest loss and associated forest carbon emissions. Where there is high dependence on biomass energy, cleaner cooking transitions are key to REDD+’s success. Given the poor track record of efforts to promote clean cooking, more evidence is needed on the potential for REDD+ to reduce unsustainable extraction of biomass energy. We present a quasi-experimental impact evaluation of REDD+ in Nepal. Unsurprisingly, we find little evidence of impacts on forest carbon in just two years. We do find that REDD+ reduced forest disturbance as measured by four plot-level indicators (signs of forest fire, soil erosion, encroachment and wildlife) that are predictive of future changes in net carbon emissions and reflective of reduced extraction pressure by households. While our analysis of household survey data does not show that REDD+ reduced harvest of forest products, we find some evidence that it reduced household dependence on firewood for cooking, possibly by increasing use of biogas. Thus, communities in Nepal appear to have improved conditions in their forests without undermining local benefits of those forests. To secure progress towards reduced emissions and improved livelihoods, interventions must be designed to effectively meet household energy needs.
abstract_zh: 减少毁林和森林退化所致排放（REDD+）包含一系列激励措施，旨在鼓励发展中国家减缓、制止并扭转森林损失及相关的森林碳排放。在生物质能源依赖度高的地方，清洁烹饪转型是REDD+成功的关键。鉴于以往推动清洁烹饪的努力成效不佳，需要更多证据来说明REDD+在减少生物质能源不可持续开采方面的潜力。我们对尼泊尔的REDD+进行了准实验影响评估。不出所料，我们发现仅两年时间内对森林碳几乎没有影响的证据。我们确实发现，REDD+减少了森林扰动，这通过四项样地级指标（森林火灾迹象、土壤侵蚀、侵占和野生动物）来衡量，这些指标可预测未来净碳排放的变化，并反映出家庭开采压力的减小。虽然我们对家庭调查数据的分析并未表明REDD+减少了森林产品的采伐，但我们发现一些证据表明它降低了家庭对烹饪用柴火的依赖，这可能是由于沼气使用增加所致。因此，尼泊尔的社区似乎在不损害森林地方效益的前提下改善了森林状况。为了切实推进减排与改善生计，干预措施必须经过设计，以有效满足家庭的能源需求。

title: Preferences and the effectiveness of behaviorchange interventions: Evidence from adoption of improved cookstoves in India
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Preference heterogeneity can influence behavior in economically significant ways, thereby influencing the effectiveness of environmental policies or interventions. We test this hypothesis in the context of efficient cooking technology in India. We use stated preference methods to first characterize household tastes for various features of a more efficient cooking technology. We then relate these typically unobserved preferences to households’ adoption decisions during an experiment that allowed them to choose between two alternatives with different features. Stated preferences help predict actual adoption: households initially classified as uninterested are less likely to purchase and use any new technology, while relative distaste for pollution is linked to selection of a cleaner technology. Because of this influence on adoption behaviors, preference heterogeneity has important implications for how environmental policies can impact various health and development outcomes.
abstract_zh: 偏好异质性会以具有经济意义的方式影响行为，从而影响环境政策或干预措施的有效性。我们在印度高效炊具技术的背景下检验这一假设。我们首先使用陈述偏好方法刻画家庭对高效炊具技术各项特征的偏好。随后，我们将这些通常不可观测的偏好与家庭在一项实验中的采用决策联系起来，该实验让家庭在两种具有不同特征的方案之间进行选择。陈述偏好有助于预测实际采用行为：最初被归类为不感兴趣的家庭购买并使用任何新技术的可能性更低，而对污染的相对厌恶则与选择更清洁技术相关。由于偏好异质性对采用行为有此影响，它对环境政策如何影响各类健康与发展结果具有重要意义。

title: Experimental evidence on promotion of electric and improved biomass cookstoves
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
abstract: Three billion people rely on traditional stoves and solid fuels. These energy use patterns exacerbate the global climate crisis (via increased carbon emissions) and forest degradation/deforestation (via daily fuelwood collection), and expose billions to toxic air pollution generated by dirty fuels. Widespread adoption of improved cookstoves (which use cleaner fuels or burn solid fuels more efficiently) may ease this “triple burden,” but recent research casts doubt on their potential, given low and slow diffusion. We challenge this pessimism based on a multiyear, three-phase field study comprising diagnosis, design, and experimental testing involving 1,000 rural Indian households. We show that demand for these improved energy technologies is high when supply chains are robust, technologies match local needs, and income and liquidity constraints are relaxed.
abstract_zh: 三十亿人依赖传统炉灶和固体燃料。这些能源使用模式加剧了全球气候危机（通过增加碳排放）和森林退化/毁林（通过每日采集柴薪），并使数十亿人暴露于劣质燃料产生的有毒空气污染之中。改良炉灶（使用更清洁的燃料或更高效地燃烧固体燃料）的广泛采用可能有助于缓解这种“三重负担”，但鉴于其扩散缓慢且规模有限，近期研究对其潜力提出了质疑。基于一项多年期、分三阶段进行的实地研究（包括诊断、设计和实验检验），我们对这种悲观看法提出挑战，该研究涉及印度1000个农村家庭。我们表明，当供应链稳健、技术符合当地需求、且收入和流动性约束得到缓解时，对这些改良能源技术的需求很高。

title: Long-term impact of a community-led sanitation campaign in India, 2005-2016
venue: Bulletin of the World Health Organization
abstract: ObjectiveTo evaluate the long-term impact of a community-led total sanitation campaign in rural India. MethodsLocal organizations in Odisha state, India worked with researchers to evaluate a community-led total sanitation campaign, which aimed to increase the demand for household latrines by raising awareness of the social costs of poor sanitation. The intervention ran from February to March 2006 in 20 randomly-selected villages and 20 control villages. Within sampled villages, we surveyed a random subset of households (around 28 households per village) at baseline in 2005 and over the subsequent 10-year period. We analysed changes in latrine ownership, latrine functionality and open defecation among approximately 1000 households. We estimated linear probability models that examined differences between households in intervention and control villages in 2006, 2010 and 2016.FindingsIn 2010, 4 years after the intervention, ownership of latrines was significantly higher (29.3 percentage points; 95% confidence interval, CI: 17.5 to 41.2) and open defecation was significantly lower (-6.8 percentage points; 95% CI: -13.1 to -1.0) among households in intervention villages, relative to controls. In 2016, intervention households continued to have higher rates of ever owning a latrine (26.3 percentage points; 95% CI: 20.9 to 31.8). However, latrine functionality and open defecation were no longer different across groups, due to both acquisition of latrines by control households and abandonment and deterioration of latrines in intervention homes. ConclusionFuture research should investigate how to maintain and rehabilitate latrines and how to sustain long-term behaviour change.
abstract_zh:
目的：评估印度农村一项社区主导的全面卫生运动的长期影响。
方法：印度奥里萨邦的地方组织与研究人员合作，评估一项社区主导的全面卫生运动，该运动旨在通过提高人们对不良卫生的社会成本的认识，增加对家用厕所的需求。干预于2006年2月至3月在20个随机选取的村庄和20个对照村庄中开展。在抽样村庄内，我们在2005年基线期以及此后十年间，对随机抽取的一部分家庭（每村约28户）进行了调查。我们分析了约1000户家庭中厕所拥有情况、厕所可用性以及露天排便的变化。我们估计了线性概率模型，考察干预村庄与对照村庄家庭在2006年、2010年和2016年之间的差异。
结果：干预4年后的2010年，与对照村庄相比，干预村庄家庭的厕所拥有率显著更高（高29.3个百分点；95%置信区间，CI：17.5至41.2），露天排便显著更低（-6.8个百分点；95% CI：-13.1至-1.0）。2016年，干预家庭“曾经拥有过厕所”的比例仍然更高（高26.3个百分点；95% CI：20.9至31.8）。然而，由于对照家庭获得了厕所，以及干预家庭的厕所被废弃和损坏，厕所可用性和露天排便在各组之间不再存在差异。
结论：未来研究应探讨如何维护和修复厕所，以及如何维持长期的行为改变。

title: Returns to rural electrification: Evidence from Bhutan
abstract: Rural electrification (RE) is a core component of the Sustainable Development Goals and a major focal point of the global development community. Despite this focus, more than one billion people worldwide lack access to electricity, and electrification rates need to more than quadruple to meet international goals. We believe that lack of progress is partly driven by a know-do gap, a misalignment between academic research and the information needs of policy makers. Most studies measuring the impacts of electrification focus on precise estimation of a few outcomes, specifically health, education and productivity impacts. Other important impacts, e.g. environmental, have remained largely unstudied. As a consequence, quantifying the full set of costs and benefits of expanding electricity access is difficult and rarely done. When cost benefit analyses are done, they are often incomplete, and conclusions are highly susceptible to unavailable or uncertain parameters. We illustrate these arguments in the case of Bhutan, where RE rates have expanded rapidly in the past few decades. We show that RE via grid extension had positive impacts related to fuelwood consumption, education, and employment, but we do not find an effect on health. We then use these impact estimates to conduct cost-benefit analyses. For the cost-benefit parameters not available from our impact evaluation, we transfer reasonable estimates from related contexts. To acknowledge the uncertainty induced by this process, we conduct Monte Carlo analyses and confirm that, while the private NPV calculations are robust to alternative parameter values, the social returns are sensitive to estimates of the social cost of carbon and costs of grid operation and maintenance. Based on this exercise, we highlight research gaps that persist and that preclude 1) careful cost-benefit analysis of RE more generally and 2) financial investment in the sector.
abstract_zh: 农村电气化（RE）是可持续发展目标的核心组成部分，也是全球发展界的一个主要关注焦点。尽管如此，全球仍有超过十亿人无法获得电力，要实现国际目标，电气化率需要增长至少四倍。我们认为，进展缓慢部分源于“知—行差距”（know-do gap），即学术研究与决策者信息需求之间的错位。大多数测量电气化影响的研究侧重于对少数结果（特别是健康、教育和生产率影响）进行精确估计。其他重要影响，例如环境影响，在很大程度上仍未得到研究。因此，要量化扩大电力供应的全部成本与收益十分困难，也很少有人去做。即便进行了成本收益分析，其往往也并不完整，且结论极易受不可得或不确定参数的影响。我们以不丹为例说明这些论点，该国的农村电气化率在过去几十年间迅速提升。我们表明，通过电网延伸实现的农村电气化对柴薪消费、教育和就业产生了正面影响，但对健康没有发现影响。随后，我们利用这些影响估计进行成本收益分析。对于我们的影响评估无法提供的成本收益参数，我们从相关背景中引用了合理的估计值。为了体现这一过程所带来的不确定性，我们进行了蒙特卡洛分析，并证实：虽然私人净现值计算对替代参数值是稳健的，但社会收益对碳的社会成本以及电网运行和维护成本的估计很敏感。基于这一练习，我们强调了仍然存在的研究空白，这些空白妨碍了：1）对农村电气化进行更为审慎的成本收益分析，总体而言；以及2）该行业的金融投资。

title: Seeking natural capital projects: Forest fires, haze, and early-life exposure in Indonesia
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
abstract:
Natural capital will be depleted rapidly and excessively if the long-term, offsite impacts of depletion are ignored. By examining the case of tropical forest burning, we illustrate such myopia: Pursuit of short-term economic gains results in air pollution that causes long-term, irreversible health impacts. We integrate longitudinal data on prenatal exposure to the 1997 Indonesian forest fires with child nutritional outcomes and find that mean exposure to air pollution during the prenatal stage is associated with a half-SD decrease in height-for-age
z
score at age 17, which is robust to several statistical checks. Because adult height is associated with income, this implies a loss of 4% of average monthly wages for approximately one million Indonesian workers born during this period. To put these human capital losses in the context of policy making, we conduct social cost–benefit analyses of oil palm plantations under different scenarios for clearing land and controlling fires. We find that clearing for oil palm plantations using mechanical methods generates higher social net benefits compared with clearing using fires. Oil palm producers, however, would be unwilling to bear the higher private costs of mechanical clearing. Therefore, we need more effective fire bans, fire suppression, and moratoriums on oil palm in Indonesia to protect natural and human capital, and increase social welfare.
abstract_zh: 如果忽视自然资本消耗的长期、异地影响，自然资本将会被迅速且过度地耗尽。以热带森林焚烧为例，我们说明了这种短视：对短期经济利益的追求导致了空气污染，进而造成长期且不可逆的健康损害。我们将1997年印度尼西亚森林火灾的产前暴露纵向数据与儿童营养结果相结合，发现产前阶段的平均空气污染暴露与17岁时身高别年龄z评分下降半个标准差相关，这一结果经受了多项统计检验的稳健性考验。由于成年身高与收入相关，这意味着在此期间出生的约一百万印度尼西亚工人平均月工资损失4%。为了将这些人力资本损失置于政策制定的背景下，我们对不同土地清理和火灾控制情景下的油棕种植园进行了社会成本收益分析。我们发现，与用火清理相比，采用机械方式清理土地以建立油棕种植园所产生的社会净收益更高。然而，油棕生产者不愿承担机械清理更高的私人成本。因此，我们需要更有效的禁火措施、灭火行动以及对印度尼西亚油棕种植的暂停令，以保护自然资本和人力资本，并增进社会福利。

title: Converting Forests to Farms: The Economic Benefits of Clearing Forests in Agricultural Settlements in the Amazon
abstract: Agricultural expansion into tropical forests is believed to bring local economic benefits at the expense of global environmental costs. The resulting tension is reflected in Brazilian government policy. The national agrarian reform program has settled farm families in the Amazon region since the 1970s, with the expectation that they will clear forests in order to farm the land. On the other hand, recent Brazilian policy initiatives seek to reduce deforestation to mitigate climate change. We contribute to the policy debate that surrounds these dual goals for the Amazon by estimating the marginal effects of new agricultural land on the full income and assets of farm settlers over a 13-year period from 1996 to 2009. Using micro panel data from agrarian settlements where forest was being rapidly cleared, and controlling for factors that would otherwise confound the relationship, we estimate the effect of converting forest to agriculture on total household income to estimate the opportunity cost of conserving forest. Our measure of income reflects any re-allocation of resources by utility maximizing households and any productivity effects due to loss of forest ecosystem services. The estimated effect of new agricultural land on income is positive, but small relative to the income per hectare of previously cleared land. However, we show that income increases investment in physical assets, which raises households’ income generating capacity and future accumulation of assets. Thus, while there is only a small immediate income gain from clearing more forest, the long-term effects on wealth are still substantial. This demonstrates that given the right conditions, conversion of forest to agricultural land can be an impetus for asset accumulation by smallholders. It also highlights the importance of considering the indirect and long-term welfare benefits of new agricultural land when assessing the opportunity costs of forest conservation.
abstract_zh: 热带森林的农业扩张被认为会以全球环境成本为代价带来地方经济收益。这种紧张关系体现在巴西的政府政策中。自20世纪70年代以来，国家农业改革计划一直在亚马逊地区安置农户家庭，期望他们砍伐森林以耕种土地。另一方面，巴西近期的政策举措旨在减少森林砍伐以缓解气候变化。我们为围绕亚马逊地区这一双重目标的政策辩论作出贡献，方法是估计1996年至2009年13年间新增农业用地对农户家庭全部收入和资产的边际效应。我们使用来自森林正被迅速砍伐的农业定居点的微观面板数据，并控制了否则会混淆两者关系的因素，估计将森林转为农业用地对家庭总收入的影响，以估计保护森林的机会成本。我们对收入的衡量反映了效用最大化家庭的任何资源再配置，以及森林生态系统服务损失所带来的任何生产率效应。估计结果显示，新增农业用地对收入有正向影响，但相对于已开垦土地每公顷的收入而言规模较小。然而，我们表明，收入增加会促进对实物资产的投资，从而提高家庭的收入创造能力和未来的资产积累。因此，尽管砍伐更多森林带来的即时收入增益很小，但对财富的长期影响仍然十分可观。这表明，在适当条件下，将森林转为农业用地可以成为小农资产积累的推动力。这也凸显了在评估保护森林的机会成本时，考虑新增农业用地的间接和长期福利收益的重要性。

title: Implementation of policies to protect planetary health - Authors' reply
NGOs and the effectiveness of interventions
abstract: Interventions in remote, rural settings face high transaction costs. We develop a model of household decision-making to evaluate how non-governmental organizations (NGOs) address these implementation-related challenges and influence intervention effectiveness. To test our model’s predictions, we create a sample of observationally similar Indian villages that differ in their prior engagement with a local development NGO. In partnership with this NGO, we then stratify a randomized technology promotion intervention on this institutional variable. We uncover a large, positive, and statistically significant ‘NGO effect’: prior engagement with the NGO increases the effectiveness of our intervention by at least 30 per cent. Our results have implications for the generalizability of experimental research conducted jointly with NGOs. In particular, attempts to scale-up findings from such work may prove less successful than anticipated if the role of NGOs is insufficiently understood. Alternatively, policy makers looking to scale-up could achieve greater success by enlisting trusted local partners.

title: Response to Kabisch and Colleagues
Through the looking glass: Environmental health economics in low and middle income countries ✶
abstract: Human interactions with the environment can profoundly impact many outcomes – health being chief among them. While the nature of environmental risks changes across time and space, the burden of disease attributable to environmental risk hovers stubbornly around one quarter of the total global disease burden. Further, environmental risks are particularly damaging to the health of children, but also to the elderly and the impoverished in low and middle income countries (LMICs). This chapter highlights the ways in which economics provides analytical insight about the human–environment relationship and about potential ways to prevent diseases. Specifically, we contend that the household production framework – which focuses on the beneficiary and households – helps us understand when and how households will avert environmental risks. While economists have been mostly on the sidelines of environmental health research, there is a growing literature from LMICs that examines three aspects of reduction in household environmental risks: (i) how households value these risk reductions, (ii) what factors drive household adoption of environmental health technologies, and (iii) what are the impacts of these technologies on household health. At the risk of simplification, our review of this literature finds relatively low values for environmental risk reductions, which is mirrored by limited adoption of environmental health technologies and, accordingly, disappointing impact on health. Economists have made less progress in linking the literatures on valuation, adoption and impacts with each other. We conclude by explaining why the next wave of research should focus on these links and on multiple risks, environmental disasters, and political economy of the supply of interventions.
abstract_zh: 人类与环境的相互作用会深刻影响许多结果，其中健康尤为重要。尽管环境风险的性质随时间和空间不断变化，但可归因于环境风险的疾病负担始终顽固地占全球总疾病负担的约四分之一。此外，环境风险对儿童健康的危害尤为严重，对低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的老年人和贫困人口也是如此。本章强调了经济学为理解人与环境的关系，以及为预防疾病的潜在途径提供分析见解的方式。具体而言，我们认为，以受益者和家庭为核心的家庭生产框架有助于我们理解家庭何时以及如何规避环境风险。尽管经济学家在环境健康研究中大多处于边缘位置，但来自低收入和中等收入国家的文献日益增多，考察了降低家庭环境风险的三个方面：（i）家庭如何评价这些风险降低，（ii）哪些因素推动家庭采用环境健康技术，以及（iii）这些技术对家庭健康有何影响。虽有简化之嫌，但我们对这一文献的综述发现，对环境风险降低的估值相对较低，这与环境健康技术的有限采用相呼应，因而其对健康的影响也令人失望。经济学家在将估值、采用和影响这三方面文献相互连接方面进展较小。我们最后解释了为什么下一波研究应聚焦于这些联系，以及多重风险、环境灾害和干预供给的政治经济学。

title: Adoption and use of a semi-gasifier cooking and water heating stove and fuel intervention in the Tibetan Plateau, China
abstract: Improved cookstoves and fuels, such as advanced gasifier stoves, carry the promise of improving health outcomes, preserving local environments, and reducing climate-forcing air pollutants. However, low adoption and use of these stoves in many settings has limited their benefits. We aimed to improve the understanding of improved stove use by describing the patterns and predictors of adoption of a semi-gasifier stove and processed biomass fuel intervention in southwestern China. Of 113 intervention homes interviewed, 79% of homes tried the stove, and the majority of these (92%) continued using it 5–10 months later. One to five months after intervention, the average proportion of days that the semi-gasifier stove was in use was modest (40.4% [95% CI 34.3–46.6]), and further declined over 13 months. Homes that received the stove in the first batch used it more frequently (67.2% [95% CI 42.1−92.3] days in use) than homes that received it in the second batch (29.3% [95% CI 13.8−44.5] days in use), likely because of stove quality and user training. Household stove use was positively associated with reported cooking needs and negatively associated with age of the main cook, household socioeconomic status, and the availability of substitute cleaner-burning stoves. Our results show that even a carefully engineered, multi-purpose semi-gasifier stove and fuel intervention contributed modestly to overall household energy use in rural China.
abstract_zh: 改良炉灶和燃料（如先进的气化炉灶）具有改善健康结果、保护当地环境和减少气候强迫性空气污染物的潜力。然而，这些炉灶在许多地方的采用率和使用率较低，限制了其效益。我们旨在通过描述中国西南部半气化炉灶和加工生物质燃料干预措施的采用模式及其预测因素，增进对改良炉灶使用情况的理解。在接受访谈的113户干预家庭中，79%的家庭试用了该炉灶，其中大多数家庭（92%）在5至10个月后仍继续使用。干预后1至5个月，半气化炉灶的平均使用天数比例不高（40.4%，95% CI 34.3–46.6），并且在13个月内进一步下降。第一批获得炉灶的家庭比第二批获得炉灶的家庭使用更为频繁（使用天数比例分别为67.2%，95% CI 42.1–92.3，以及29.3%，95% CI 13.8–44.5），这很可能是由于炉灶质量和用户培训的差异。家庭炉灶使用与报告的烹饪需求呈正相关，与主要炊事者的年龄、家庭社会经济地位以及替代性更清洁燃烧炉灶的可得性呈负相关。我们的结果表明，即使是经过精心工程设计、多用途的半气化炉灶和燃料干预，对中国农村家庭的总体能源使用也只有适度的贡献。

title: Biogas Stoves Reduce Firewood Use, Household Air Pollution, and Hospital Visits in Odisha, India
abstract: Traditional cooking using biomass is associated with ill health, local environmental degradation, and regional climate change. Clean stoves (liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), biogas, and electric) are heralded as a solution, but few studies have demonstrated their environmental health benefits in field settings. We analyzed the impact of mainly biogas (as well as electric and LPG) stove use on social, environmental, and health outcomes in two districts in Odisha, India, where the Indian government has promoted household biogas. We established a cross-sectional observational cohort of 105 households that use either traditional mud stoves or improved cookstoves (ICS). Our multidisciplinary team conducted surveys, environmental air sampling, fuel weighing, and health measurements. We examined associations between traditional or improved stove use and primary outcomes, stratifying households by proximity to major industrial plants. ICS use was associated with 91% reduced use of firewood ( p < 0.01), substantial time savings for primary cooks, a 72% reduction in PM 2.5, a 78% reduction in PAH levels, and significant reductions in water-soluble organic carbon and nitrogen ( p < 0.01) in household air samples. ICS use was associated with reduced time in the hospital with acute respiratory infection and reduced diastolic blood pressure but not with other health measurements. We find many significant gains from promoting rural biogas stoves in a context in which traditional stove use persists, although pollution levels in ICS households still remained above WHO guidelines.
abstract_zh: 传统的生物质烹饪与不良健康、当地环境退化和区域气候变化相关。清洁炉灶（液化石油气（LPG）、沼气和电炉）被视为解决方案，但很少有研究在实地环境中证明其环境健康效益。我们分析了印度奥里萨邦两个县中，主要使用沼气（以及电力和液化石油气）炉灶对社会、环境和健康结果的影响，该邦印度政府一直在推广家用沼气。我们建立了一个横断面观察队列，包含105户使用传统泥炉或改良炉灶（ICS）的家庭。我们的多学科团队开展了调查、环境空气采样、燃料称重和健康测量。我们按家庭与主要工业厂区的距离进行分层，考察了传统或改良炉灶的使用与主要结果之间的关联。改良炉灶的使用与柴薪用量减少91%（p < 0.01）、主要炊事者节省大量时间相关，并与家庭空气样本中PM2.5降低72%、多环芳烃（PAH）水平降低78%，以及水溶性有机碳和氮显著降低（p < 0.01）相关。改良炉灶的使用与因急性呼吸道感染住院的时间减少，以及舒张压降低相关，但与其他健康指标无关。在传统炉灶使用仍然普遍的背景下，我们发现推广农村沼气炉灶带来了许多显著收益，尽管改良炉灶家庭的污染水平仍高于世界卫生组织的指导值。

title: Building the evidence base for REDD+: Study design and methods for evaluating the impacts of conservation interventions on local well-being
venue: Global environmental change : human and policy dimensions
abstract: Climate change mitigation in developing countries is increasingly expected to generate co-benefits that help meet sustainable development goals. This has been an expectation and a hotly contested issue in REDD+ (reducing emissions from deforestation and forest degradation) since its inception. While the core purpose of REDD+ is to reduce carbon emissions, its legitimacy and success also depend on its impacts on local well-being. To effectively safeguard against negative impacts, we need to know whether and which well-being outcomes can be attributed to REDD+. Yet, distinguishing the effects of choosing particular areas for REDD+ from the effects of the interventions themselves remains a challenge. The Global Comparative Study (GCS) on REDD+ employed a quasi-experimental before-after-control-intervention (BACI) study design to address this challenge and evaluate the impacts of 16 REDD+ pilots across the tropics. We find that the GCS approach allows identification of control groups that represent the counterfactual, thereby permitting attribution of outcomes to REDD+. The GCS experience belies many of the common critiques of the BACI design, especially concerns about collecting baseline data on control groups. Our findings encourage and validate the early planning and up-front investments required to evaluate the local impacts of global climate change mitigation efforts with confidence. The stakes are high, both for the global environment and for local populations directly affected by those efforts. The standards for evidence should be concomitantly high.
abstract_zh: 在发展中国家，气候变化减缓正日益被期望产生有助于实现可持续发展目标的协同效益。自REDD+（减少毁林和森林退化所致排放）诞生以来，这一期望一直是一个备受争议的议题。尽管REDD+的核心目的是减少碳排放，但其合法性和成功也取决于其对当地福祉的影响。为有效防范负面影响，我们需要了解哪些福祉结果可以归因于REDD+。然而，区分选择特定区域实施REDD+的效应与干预本身的效应，仍然是一项挑战。全球比较研究（GCS）采用准实验性的“前后—对照—干预”（BACI）研究设计来应对这一挑战，以评估热带地区16个REDD+试点的影响。我们发现，GCS方法能够识别代表反事实的对照组，从而使结果可以归因于REDD+。GCS的经验驳斥了对BACI设计的许多常见批评，尤其是关于收集对照组基线数据的担忧。我们的发现鼓励并验证了评估全球气候变化减缓努力对当地影响所需的早期规划和前期投入，以确保结论可信。风险很高，既关乎全球环境，也关乎直接受这些努力影响的当地人口。因此，证据标准也应相应地提高。

title: Costs, cobenefits, and community responses to REDD+: A case study from Nepal
abstract: We examine the role of subnational institutions in carbon sequestration and assess whether community forest user groups can meet both existing forest needs and international carbon demand. By conducting a qualitative evaluation of a pilot program in Nepal that made carbon payments to forest user groups, we examine if community forestry institutions can be effective, efficient, and equitable in implementing Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation (REDD)+. Our evaluation relies on focus group discussions, meetings, and community and program documents of forestry user groups that participated in the REDD+ pilot and matched groups that did not. Compared to control groups, REDD+ user groups appear to be more effective in carbon sequestration, perhaps because of increased prevention of forest fires and grazing, nursery establishment, and other forest management. REDD+ user groups report a larger number of forest conservation, forest utilization, and community development activities relative to control groups. Participating communities bear transaction costs of US$4.5/hectare and implementation costs of US$2.5/hectare on average (or NPR 50,000 (US$600) per year). The mean REDD+ rent per ton of additional carbon sequestered was US$1.3. Targeting of benefits improves partly because some marginalized groups, particularly women, participate more in the planning and management. In terms of equity, microcredit and capacity development activities were skewed to the poorest households, whereas alternate fuel and carbon monitoring were more advantageous to middle or high income households. Overall, our analyses suggest that REDD+ activities can be successfully executed, if communities receive technical and capacity building support for institutional strengthening, in addition to carbon payments.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了地方机构在碳封存中的作用，并评估社区森林用户群体能否同时满足现有森林需求和国际碳需求。通过对尼泊尔一项向森林用户群体支付碳补偿的试点项目进行定性评估，我们考察了社区林业机构能否有效、高效且公平地实施减少毁林和森林退化所致排放（REDD）+。我们的评估依赖于焦点小组讨论、会议，以及参与REDD+试点的森林用户群体和与之匹配的未参与群体的社区及项目文件。与对照组相比，REDD+用户群体在碳封存方面表现更为有效，这可能是由于其更加注重预防森林火灾和放牧，并开展了苗圃建设及其他森林管理活动。相对于对照组，REDD+用户群体报告了更多的森林保护、森林利用和社区发展活动。参与社区平均承担每公顷4.5美元的交易成本和每公顷2.5美元的实施成本（或每年50,000尼泊尔卢比（600美元））。每吨新增封存碳的平均REDD+租金为1.3美元。受益分配有所改善，部分原因是一些边缘化群体，特别是妇女，更多地参与了规划和管理。在公平性方面，小额信贷和能力建设活动偏向最贫困家庭，而替代燃料和碳监测则对中等或高收入家庭更为有利。总体而言，我们的分析表明，如果社区在碳补偿之外，还获得了加强制度建设的技术和能力建设支持，REDD+活动可以得到成功实施。

title: Ecosystem change and human health: implementation economics and policy
venue: Philosophical transactions of the Royal Society of London. Series B, Biological sciences
abstract:
Several recent initiatives such as
Planetary Health
,
EcoHealth
and
One Health
claim that human health depends on flourishing natural ecosystems. However, little has been said about the operational and implementation challenges of health-oriented conservation actions on the ground.
