We contend that ecological–epidemiological research must be complemented by a form of implementation science that examines: (i) the links between specific conservation actions and the resulting ecological changes, and (ii) how this ecological change impacts human health and well-being, when human behaviours are considered. Drawing on the policy evaluation tradition in public economics, first, we present three examples of recent social science research on conservation interventions that affect human health. These examples are from low- and middle-income countries in the tropics and subtropics. Second, drawing on these examples, we present three propositions related to impact evaluation and non-market valuation that can help guide future multidisciplinary research on conservation and human health. Research guided by these propositions will allow stakeholders to determine how ecosystem-mediated strategies for health promotion compare with more conventional biomedical prevention and treatment strategies for safeguarding health.
This article is part of the themed issue ‘Conservation, biodiversity and infectious disease: scientific evidence and policy implications’.
abstract_zh:
近期若干倡议，如“行星健康”（Planetary Health）、“生态健康”（EcoHealth）和“同一健康”（One Health），都主张人类健康依赖于繁茂的自然生态系统。然而，关于以健康为导向的保护行动在实地的运营和实施挑战，人们却鲜有论述。我们认为，生态—流行病学研究必须辅之以一种实施科学，该科学应考察：（i）特定保护行动与由此产生的生态变化之间的联系，以及（ii）在考虑人类行为的情况下，这种生态变化如何影响人类健康和福祉。借鉴公共经济学中的政策评估传统，我们首先介绍了三个近期关于影响人类健康的保护干预的社会科学研究案例，这些案例来自热带和亚热带的低收入和中等收入国家。其次，基于这些案例，我们提出了三项与影响评估和非市场价值评估有关的命题，以帮助指导未来关于保护与人类健康的多学科研究。遵循这些命题开展的研究将使利益相关方能够判断，以生态系统为媒介的健康促进策略与传统的生物医学预防和治疗策略相比，如何用于保障健康。
本文是主题专刊“保护、生物多样性与传染病：科学证据与政策含义”的一部分。

title: Explaining environmental health behaviors: Evidence from rural India on the influence of discount rates
abstract: The authors examine whether high personal discount rates help explain why and which households in developing countries under-invest in seemingly low-cost options to avert environmental health threats, including bednets, clean cooking fuels, individual household latrines, water treatment and handwashing. First, the authors elicit personal discount rates by combining a simple randomized experiment with detailed surveys of over 10,000 rural households in Maharashtra, India. Personal discount rates are lower for women, for better-off households, and for households who can access formal credit. Secondly, they show that the discount rate is negatively related to a suite of behaviors that mitigate environmental health threats, from very low-cost steps like washing hands to more significant investments like household latrines, even after controlling for socio-economic status, access to credit, public infrastructure and services, and relevant beliefs.
abstract_zh: 作者考察了较高的个人贴现率是否有助于解释，为何以及哪些发展中国家家庭在规避环境健康威胁的、看似低成本的措施上投资不足，这些措施包括蚊帐、清洁炊事燃料、家用厕所、水处理和洗手。首先，作者将一项简单的随机实验与对印度马哈拉施特拉邦超过10,000户农村家庭的详细调查相结合，得出个人贴现率。女性、较富裕家庭以及能够获得正规信贷的家庭，其个人贴现率较低。其次，作者表明，贴现率与一系列减轻环境健康威胁的行为呈负相关，这些行为从洗手这类成本极低的步骤，到家用厕所这类较大的投资不等，即使在控制了社会经济地位、信贷获取、公共基础设施和服务以及相关信念之后，结论依然成立。

title: Implementation Science to Accelerate Clean Cooking for Public Health
Implementation of policies to protect planetary health
Water in development
What are Households Willing to Pay for Improved Water Access? Results from a Meta-Analysis
abstract: Although several factors contribute to low rates of access to improved water and sanitation in the developing world, it is especially important to understand and measure household demand for these services. One valuable source of information regarding demand is the growing empirical literature that has applied stated preference methods to estimate households’ willingness to pay (WTP). Because it is difficult to generalize and support planning based on this scattered literature, we conduct a meta-analysis to take stock of the worldwide sample of household WTP for improved drinking water services. Using 171 WTP estimates drawn from 60 studies, we first describe this sample and then examine the potential factors that explain variation in WTP estimates. Our results suggest that households are willing to pay between approximately $3 and $30 per month for improvements in water access. Specifically, in line with economic theory and intuition, WTP is sensitive to scope (the magnitude of improvement in drinking water services), as well as household income, and stated-preference elicitation method. We demonstrate how our results can be used to predict household-level WTP for selected improvements in drinking water access in regions with low coverage, and find that private benefits exceed the cost of provision.
abstract_zh: 尽管有多种因素导致发展中国家改善用水和卫生设施的覆盖率较低，但理解和衡量家庭对这些服务的需求尤为重要。关于需求的一项宝贵信息来源，是日益增多的运用陈述偏好方法估计家庭支付意愿（WTP）的实证文献。由于这些分散的文献难以概括，也难以为规划提供支持，我们开展了一项元分析，以盘点全球范围内家庭对改善饮用水服务的支付意愿样本。我们使用来自60项研究的171个支付意愿估计值，首先描述了该样本，然后考察了解释支付意愿估计值差异的潜在因素。我们的结果表明，家庭为改善用水服务每月愿意支付约3至30美元。具体而言，与经济理论和直觉相一致，支付意愿对改善范围（饮用水服务改善的幅度）、家庭收入以及陈述偏好的诱导方法都很敏感。我们展示了如何利用我们的结果，预测低覆盖率地区家庭对特定饮用水改善项目的支付意愿，并发现私人收益超过了供给成本。

title: When, Where, and How Nature Matters for Ecosystem Services: Challenges for the Next Generation of Ecosystem Service Models
abstract: Many decision-makers are looking to science to clarify how nature supports human well-being. Scientists’ responses have typically focused on empirical models of the provision of ecosystem services (ES) and resulting decision-support tools. Although such tools have captured some of the complexities of ES, they can be difficult to adapt to new situations. Globally useful tools that predict the provision of multiple ES under different decision scenarios have proven challenging to develop. Questions from decision-makers and limitations of existing decision-support tools indicate three crucial research frontiers for incorporating cutting-edge ES science into decision-support tools: (1) understanding the complex dynamics of ES in space and time, (2) linking ES provision to human well-being, and (3) determining the potential for technology to substitute for or enhance ES. We explore these frontiers in-depth, explaining why each is important and how existing knowledge at their cutting edges can be incorporated to improve ES decision-making tools.
abstract_zh: 许多决策者希望借助科学来阐明自然如何支持人类福祉。科学家的回应通常集中于生态系统服务（ES）供给的实证模型以及由此形成的决策支持工具。尽管此类工具已捕捉到生态系统服务的部分复杂性，但它们往往难以适应新情境。能够预测不同决策情景下多种生态系统服务供给的全球通用工具，其开发已被证明十分困难。决策者的问题以及现有决策支持工具的局限性，指向了将前沿生态系统服务科学纳入决策支持工具的三个关键研究前沿：（1）理解生态系统服务在空间和时间上的复杂动态，（2）将生态系统服务供给与人类福祉联系起来，以及（3）确定技术替代或增强生态系统服务的潜力。我们深入探讨了这些前沿，阐释了每一前沿为何重要，以及如何将这些前沿的现有知识纳入以改进生态系统服务决策工具。

title: Econometric Evidence on Forest Ecosystem Services: Deforestation and Flooding in Malaysia
abstract: Governments around the world are increasingly invoking hydrological services, such as flood mitigation and water purification, as a justification for forest conservation programs in upstream areas. Yet, rigorous empirical evidence that these programs are actually delivering the intended services remains scant. We investigate the effect of deforestation on flood-mitigation services in Peninsular Malaysia during 1984–2000, a period when detailed data on both flood events and land-use change are available for 31 river basins. Floods are the most common natural disaster in tropical regions, but the ability of tropical forests to mitigate large-scale floods associated with heavy rainfall events remains disputed. We find that the conversion of inland tropical forests to oil palm and rubber plantations significantly increased the number of days flooded during the wettest months of the year. Our results demonstrate the importance of using disaggregated land-use data, controlling for potentially confounding factors, and applying appropriate estimators in econometric studies on forest ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 世界各国政府日益以水文服务（如洪水缓解和水净化）作为上游地区森林保护项目的理由。然而，这些项目是否真正提供了预期服务，严格的实证证据仍然稀缺。我们考察了1984至2000年间马来西亚半岛森林砍伐对洪水缓解服务的影响，这一时期，31个流域的洪水事件和土地利用变化数据都有详细记录。洪水是热带地区最常见的自然灾害，但热带森林缓解与强降雨相关的大规模洪水的能力，仍存在争议。我们发现，内陆热带森林转为油棕和橡胶种植园，显著增加了一年中最湿润月份的洪涝天数。我们的结果表明，在关于森林生态系统服务的计量经济学研究中，使用分类细化的土地利用数据、控制潜在的混杂因素并采用恰当的估计量都十分重要。

title: How much do alternative cookstoves reduce biomass fuel use? Evidence from North India
abstract: Despite widespread global efforts to promote clean cookstoves to achieve improvements in air and forest quality, and to reduce global climate change, surprisingly little is known about the degree to which these actually reduce biomass fuel consumption in real-world settings. Using data from in-house weighing of fuel conducted in rural India, we examine the impact of cleaner cookstoves - most of which are LPG stoves - on three key outcomes related to solid fuel use. Our results suggest that using a clean cookstove is associated with daily reductions of about 4.5. kg of biomass fuel, 160 fewer minutes cooking on traditional stoves, and 105 fewer minutes collecting biomass fuels. These findings of substantial savings are robust to the use of estimators with varying levels of control for selection, and to alternative data obtained from household self-reports. Our results support the idea that efforts to promote clean stoves among poor rural households can reduce solid fuel use and cooking time, and that rebound effects toward greater amounts of cooking on multiple stoves are not sufficient to eliminate these gains. We also find, however, that households who have greater wealth, fewer members, are in less marginalized groups, and practice other health-averting behaviors, are more likely to use these cleaner stoves, which suggests that socio-economic status plays an important role in determining who benefits from such technologies. Future efforts to capture social benefits must therefore consider how to promote the use of alternative technologies by poor households, given that these households are least likely to own clean stoves.
abstract_zh: 尽管全球范围内广泛推动清洁炉灶，以改善空气和森林质量并减缓全球气候变化，但人们对这些炉灶在现实环境中究竟在多大程度上减少生物质燃料消耗，仍知之甚少。利用在印度农村进行的户内燃料称重数据，我们考察了清洁炉灶（其中大多数是液化石油气炉灶）对与固体燃料使用相关的三项关键结果的影响。我们的结果表明，使用清洁炉灶与每日生物质燃料减少约4.5千克、传统炉灶烹饪时间减少160分钟，以及收集生物质燃料的时间减少105分钟相关。这些显著节约的发现，在使用控制选择程度不同的估计量，以及采用家庭自我报告的替代数据时，依然稳健。我们的结果支持以下观点：在贫困农村家庭中推广清洁炉灶，能够减少固体燃料使用和烹饪时间，且多炉灶并用所导致的回弹效应（即烹饪量增加），不足以抵消这些收益。然而，我们也发现，财富较多、家庭成员较少、处于较少边缘化群体，并且采取其他避害健康行为的家庭，更有可能使用这些更清洁的炉灶，这表明社会经济地位在决定谁能从这些技术中获益方面发挥着重要作用。因此，未来为获取社会效益的努力，必须考虑如何促使贫困家庭使用替代技术，因为这些家庭最不可能拥有清洁炉灶。

title: Valuing Water Purification by Forests: An Analysis of Malaysian Panel Data
abstract: Water purification might be the most frequently invoked example of an economically valuable ecosystem service, yet the impacts of upstream land use on downstream municipal water treatment costs remain poorly understood. This is especially true in developing countries, where rates of deforestation are highest and cost-effective expansion of safe water supplies is needed the most. We present the first econometric study to estimate directly the effect of tropical forests on water treatment cost. We exploit a rich panel dataset from Malaysia, which enables us to control for a wide range of potentially confounding factors. We find significant, robust evidence that protecting both virgin and logged forests against conversion to nonforest land uses reduced water treatment costs, with protection of virgin forests reducing costs more. The marginal value of this water purification service varied greatly across treatment plants, thus implying that the service offered a stronger rationale for forest protection in some locations than others. On average, the service value was large relative to treatment plants’ expenditures on priced inputs, but it was very small compared to producer surpluses for competing land uses. For various reasons, however, the latter comparison exaggerates the shortfall between the benefits and the costs of enhancing water purification by protecting forests. Moreover, forest protection decisions that appear to be economically unjustified when only water purification is considered might be justified when a broader range of services is taken into account.
abstract_zh: 水净化可能是经济上有价值的生态系统服务中最常被援引的例子，然而，上游土地利用对下游市政水处理成本的影响仍然知之甚少。在森林砍伐率最高、而安全饮用水供给的成本效益扩展最为迫切的发展中国家，情况尤其如此。我们提出了首个直接估计热带森林对水处理成本影响的计量经济学研究。我们利用马来西亚一个丰富的面板数据集，从而能够控制广泛的潜在混杂因素。我们发现有显著且稳健的证据表明，保护原始森林和采伐后森林免于转为非森林用地，降低了水处理成本，其中保护原始森林的成本降低幅度更大。这一水净化服务的边际价值在不同水处理厂之间差异很大，因此表明，该服务在某些地点比在其他地点更有理由支持森林保护。平均而言，该服务的价值相对于水处理厂在计价投入品上的支出而言较大，但与竞争性土地用途的生产者剩余相比则非常小。然而，由于种种原因，后一比较夸大了通过保护森林来增强水净化的收益与成本之间的差距。此外，仅考虑水净化时看似经济上不合理的森林保护决策，在考虑更广泛服务时可能是合理的。

title: Do Decentralized Community Treatment Plants Provide Better Water? Evidence from Andhra Pradesh
abstract: Highly advanced, community-level drinking water treatment facilities are increasingly seen as water supply solutions in locations where piped in-house water systems are nonexistent or unreliable. These systems utilize combined technologies, such as advanced filtration plus ultraviolet disinfection or reverse osmosis, which are known to be highly effective for the removal of pathogens and other water contaminants. Yet there is a paucity of rigorous evidence on whether the community-level treatment model delivers water quality, health, or other benefits to households that source water from them. This paper utilizes a quasi-experimental approach that combines construction of counterfactual groups of villages and households and a difference-in-difference methodology to examine such impacts. We find low rates of sourcing water from the facilities (~10%), and little evidence of benefits among households living in villages receiving a community water system (CWS). Particularly among users of the CWS, we also observe short-term increases in the number of drinking water sources used and in monthly expenses on drinking water combined with decreases in in-house water treatment, and higher reported rates of diarrheal diseases among children. In the longer term, as the CWS model spread throughout the region, we observe that most of the differences between households in treated and control communities fade away. These findings suggest that caution and additional scrutiny is warranted before concluding that such systems provide safer water to households in communities facing drinking water quality problems.
abstract_zh: 高度先进的社区级饮用水处理设施，在没有或无法可靠获得管道入户供水系统的地方，正日益被视为供水解决方案。这些系统采用组合技术，例如先进过滤加紫外线消毒或反渗透，已知其对去除病原体和其他水体污染物非常有效。然而，关于社区级处理模式是否能为从中取水的家庭带来水质、健康或其他益处，严谨的证据仍然匮乏。本文采用一种准实验方法，结合构建反事实的村庄和家庭对照组，以及双重差分方法来考察此类影响。我们发现，从这些设施取水的比例很低（约10%），且在接受社区供水系统（CWS）的村庄中，家庭几乎没有获得益处的证据。特别是在CWS的用户中，我们还观察到饮用水水源使用数量和饮用水月支出的短期增加，同时室内水处理减少，并且儿童腹泻疾病的自我报告发生率更高。从长期来看，随着CWS模式在该地区推广，我们观察到处理组与对照组社区家庭之间的大部分差异逐渐消失。这些发现表明，在断定此类系统能为面临饮用水质量问题的社区家庭提供更安全的水之前，需要保持谨慎并进行更多审查。

title: Do Payments Pay Off? Evidence from Participation in Costa Rica's PES Program
abstract: Payments for environmental services (PES) are often viewed as a way to simultaneously improve conservation outcomes and the wellbeing of rural households who receive the payments. However, evidence for such win-win outcomes has been elusive. We add to the growing literature on conservation program impacts by using primary household survey data to evaluate the socioeconomic impacts of participation in Costa Rica's PES program. Despite the substantial cash transfers to voluntary participants in this program, we do not detect any evidence of impacts on their wealth or self-reported well-being using a quasi-experimental design. These results are consistent with the common claim that voluntary PES do not harm participants, but they beg the question of why landowners participate if they do not benefit. Landowners in our sample voluntarily renewed their contracts after five years in the program and thus are unlikely to have underestimated their costs of participation. They apparently did not invest additional income from the program in farm inputs such as cattle or hired labor, since both decreased as a result of participation. Nor do we find evidence that participation encouraged moves off-farm. Instead, semi-structured interviews suggest that participants joined the program to secure their property rights and contribute to the public good of forest conservation. Thus, in order to understand the social impacts of PES, we need to look beyond simple economic rationales and material outcomes.
abstract_zh: 环境服务付费（PES）常被视为一种途径，可同时改善保护成效和接受付款的农村家庭的福祉。然而，这种双赢结果的证据一直难以获得。我们利用原始家庭调查数据，评估哥斯达黎加PES项目参与者的社会经济影响，从而为日益增多的保护项目影响文献增添证据。尽管该项目向自愿参与者提供了大量现金转移支付，但采用准实验设计，我们未发现其对参与者财富或自我报告的福祉有任何影响。这些结果与“自愿性PES不会损害参与者”的常见论断一致，但也引出了一个问题：如果参与者并未从中获益，那么地主为何仍然参与？样本中的地主在项目实施五年后自愿续签了合同，因此不太可能低估了参与成本。他们似乎并未将项目收入投资于农业投入品，例如牲畜或雇佣劳动力，因为两者在参与后均有所减少。我们也未发现参与促使其迁往农场之外的证据。相反，半结构化访谈表明，参与者加入项目是为了确保其财产权，并为森林保护这一公共利益做出贡献。因此，要理解PES的社会影响，我们需要超越简单的经济动机和物质结果。

title: Do protected areas reduce blue carbon emissions? A quasi-experimental evaluation of mangroves in Indonesia
abstract: Mangroves provide multiple ecosystem services such as blue carbon sequestration, storm protection, and unique habitat for species. Despite these services, mangroves are being lost at rapid rates around the world. Using the best available biophysical and socio-economic data, we present the first rigorous large-scale evaluation of the effectiveness of protected areas (PAs) at conserving mangroves and reducing blue carbon emissions. We focus on Indonesia as it has the largest absolute area of mangroves (about 22.6% of the world's mangroves), is one of the most diverse in terms of mangrove species and has been losing its mangroves at a very fast rate. Specifically, we apply quasi-experimental techniques (combining propensity score and covariate matching, differences-in-differences, and post-matching bias adjustments) to assess whether PAs prevented mangrove loss between 2000 and 2010. Our results show that marine protected areas reduced mangrove loss by about 14,000ha and avoided blue carbon emissions of approximately 13 million metric tons (CO2 equivalent). However, we find no evidence that species management PAs stalled the loss of mangroves. We conclude by providing illustrative estimates of the blue carbon benefits of establishing PAs, which can be cost-effective policies for mitigating climate change and biodiversity loss.
abstract_zh: 红树林提供多种生态系统服务，如蓝碳封存、风暴防护以及为物种提供独特栖息地。尽管如此，全球各地红树林仍在快速丧失。利用现有最佳的生物物理和社会经济数据，我们首次对保护区（PA）在保护红树林和减少蓝碳排放方面的成效进行了严格的大规模评估。我们聚焦于印度尼西亚，因为其红树林绝对面积最大（约占全球红树林的22.6%），物种多样性在全球名列前茅，并且一直以非常快的速度丧失红树林。具体而言，我们应用准实验技术（结合倾向得分与协变量匹配、双重差分以及匹配后偏差调整），评估2000至2010年间保护区是否阻止了红树林的丧失。我们的结果表明，海洋保护区使红树林丧失减少了约14,000公顷，并避免了约1300万公吨的蓝碳排放（以CO2当量计）。然而，我们没有发现证据表明物种管理类保护区遏制了红树林的丧失。最后，我们提供了设立保护区所带来蓝碳效益的示意性估算，这些保护区可能是减缓气候变化和生物多样性丧失的具有成本效益的政策。

title: Estimating the Impacts of Local Policy Innovation: The Synthetic Control Method Applied to Tropical Deforestation
abstract: Quasi-experimental methods increasingly are used to evaluate the impacts of conservation interventions by generating credible estimates of counterfactual baselines. These methods generally require large samples for statistical comparisons, presenting a challenge for evaluating innovative policies implemented within a few pioneering jurisdictions. Single jurisdictions often are studied using comparative methods, which rely on analysts' selection of best case comparisons. The synthetic control method (SCM) offers one systematic and transparent way to select cases for comparison, from a sizeable pool, by focusing upon similarity in outcomes before the intervention. We explain SCM, then apply it to one local initiative to limit deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon. The municipality of Paragominas launched a multi-pronged local initiative in 2008 to maintain low deforestation while restoring economic production. This was a response to having been placed, due to high deforestation, on a federal "blacklist" that increased enforcement of forest regulations and restricted access to credit and output markets. The local initiative included mapping and monitoring of rural land plus promotion of economic alternatives compatible with low deforestation. The key motivation for the program may have been to reduce the costs of blacklisting. However its stated purpose was to limit deforestation, and thus we apply SCM to estimate what deforestation would have been in a (counterfactual) scenario of no local initiative. We obtain a plausible estimate, in that deforestation patterns before the intervention were similar in Paragominas and the synthetic control, which suggests that after several years, the initiative did lower deforestation (significantly below the synthetic control in 2012). This demonstrates that SCM can yield helpful land-use counterfactuals for single units, with opportunities to integrate local and expert knowledge and to test innovations and permutations on policies that are implemented in just a few locations.
abstract_zh: 准实验方法越来越多地被用于评估保护干预措施的影响，其途径是生成可信的反事实基准。这些方法通常需要较大的样本以进行统计比较，这给评估仅在少数先行地区实施的创新政策带来了挑战。对于单一地区，通常采用比较方法进行研究，但这依赖于分析者对最佳比较案例的选择。合成控制法（SCM）提供了一种系统且透明的方法，可以从庞大的备选池中，依据干预前结果的相似性来选择比较案例。我们阐述了SCM，并将其应用于巴西亚马逊地区一项限制森林砍伐的地方性倡议。帕拉戈米纳斯（Paragominas）市于2008年发起了一项多管齐下的地方性倡议，旨在维持较低的森林砍伐水平，同时恢复经济生产。这一倡议是对该市因高森林砍伐率而被列入联邦“黑名单”的回应，该名单加强了对森林法规的执法，并限制了其获得信贷和进入产品市场的机会。该地方倡议包括对农村土地进行测绘和监测，并推广与低森林砍伐相容的经济替代方案。该项目的主要动机可能是降低被列入黑名单的成本。然而，其既定目标是限制森林砍伐，因此我们运用SCM估计，在没有该地方倡议的（反事实）情景下，森林砍伐将会是什么水平。我们得到了一个合理的估计：干预前帕拉戈米纳斯与合成控制地区的森林砍伐格局相似，这表明经过数年，该倡议确实降低了森林砍伐（在2012年显著低于合成控制地区）。这说明，SCM能够为单一单元提供有益的土地利用反事实，并且有机会整合地方和专家知识，检验仅在少数地点实施的政策的创新与变体。

title: Estimating the impacts of conservation on ecosystem services and poverty by integrating modeling and evaluation
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
abstract_zh: 研究表明，生态系统保护可能提供的服务能够被建模、制图和估值；然而，这类综合性研究尚未被系统性地应用于估计项目对生态系统服务供给的实际影响。我们通过展示巴西、哥斯达黎加、印度尼西亚和泰国的保护区如何储存碳并提供价值至少50亿美元的生态系统服务，弥合了这一鸿沟。对碳的影响在某些地区与加剧贫困相关，而在另一些地区则与减少贫困相关。我们描述了一项改进保护规划的议程，包括：（i）研究对其他生态系统服务的影响，（ii）揭示保护项目影响人类福利的机制，以及（iii）更全面地比较保护影响的成本与收益。

title: National-level differences in the adoption of environmental health technologies: a cross-border comparison from Benin and Togo
abstract: Environmental health problems such as malaria, respiratory infections, diarrhoea and malnutrition pose very high burdens on the poor rural people in much of the tropics. Recent research on key interventions-the adoption and use of relatively cheap and effective environmental health technologies-has focused primarily on the influence of demand-side household-level drivers. Relatively few studies of the promotion and use of these technologies have considered the role of contextual factors such as governance, the enabling environment and national policies because of the challenges of cross-country comparisons. We exploit a natural experimental setting by comparing household adoption across the Benin-Togo national border that splits the Tamberma Valley in West Africa. Households across the border share the same culture, ethnicity, weather, physiographic features, livelihoods and infrastructure; however, they are located in countries at virtually opposite ends of the institutional spectrum of democratic elections, voice and accountability, effective governance and corruption. Binary choice models and rigorous non-parametric matching estimators confirm that households in Benin are more likely than households in Togo to plant soybeans, build improved cookstoves and purchase mosquito nets, ceteris paribus. Although we cannot identify the exact mechanism for the large and significant national-level differences in technology adoption, our findings suggest that contextual institutional factors can be more important than household characteristics for technology adoption.
abstract_zh: 在热带地区的大部分地方，疟疾、呼吸道感染、腹泻和营养不良等环境健康问题给贫困农村人口带来了沉重负担。近期关于关键干预措施——即采用和使用相对廉价且有效的环境健康技术——的研究，主要聚焦于需求侧的家庭层面驱动因素。由于跨国比较存在挑战，较少有关于这些技术推广和使用的研究考虑治理、支持性环境和国家政策等背景因素的作用。我们利用一个自然实验情境，比较了横跨贝宁—多哥国界两侧的家庭采用情况，该国界分割了西非的坦贝尔马河谷（Tamberma Valley）。边界两侧的家庭共享相同的文化、民族、气候、地貌特征、生计和基础设施；然而，两国在民主选举、话语权与问责、有效治理和腐败控制等制度光谱上几乎处于截然相反的两端。二元选择模型和严格的非参数匹配估计量证实，在其他条件相同的情况下，贝宁的家庭比多哥的家庭更可能种植大豆、建造改良炉灶并购买蚊帐。尽管我们无法确定造成技术采用全国性显著差异的确切机制，但我们的发现表明，就技术采用而言，背景性的制度因素可能比家庭特征更为重要。

title: Nature's call: Impacts of sanitation choices in Orissa, India
abstract: Worldwide, over 2.5 billion people lack access to basic sanitation, a situation that contributes to 2 million annual diarrhea-related child deaths and substantial morbidity. Yet rigorous evaluations of sanitation behaviors and their health and welfare impacts are rare. This article uses a randomized sanitation promotion campaign in Orissa, India, to evaluate child health and household welfare outcomes. The sanitation campaign increased households’ ownership and use of latrines and improved children’s mid-upper-arm circumference, height, and weight z-scores. Switching from open defecation to latrine use also saved time and increased satisfaction in sanitation conditions. We use our results to illustrate the cost-benefit calculus underlying this seemingly unglamorous and mundane household choice with potentially large environmental externalities.
abstract_zh: 全球有超过25亿人无法获得基本卫生设施，这一状况每年导致约200万儿童死于腹泻相关疾病，并造成大量疾病负担。然而，对卫生行为及其对健康和福利影响的严格评估却十分罕见。本文利用印度奥里萨邦（Orissa）开展的一项随机化卫生推广运动，评估儿童健康和家庭福利结果。该卫生运动提高了家庭拥有和使用厕所的比例，并改善了儿童的上臂中围、身高和体重z值。从露天排便转向使用厕所还节省了时间，并提高了卫生条件方面的满意度。我们利用这些结果，阐释这一看似平淡无奇的家庭选择背后的成本收益权衡，该选择可能带来巨大的环境外部性。

title: Piloting improved cookstoves in India
abstract: Despite the potential of improved cookstoves to reduce the adverse environmental and health impacts of solid fuel use, their adoption and use remains low. Social marketing-with its focus on the marketing mix of promotion, product, price, and place-offers a useful way to understand household behaviors and design campaigns to change biomass fuel use. We report on a series of pilots across 3 Indian states that use different combinations of the marketing mix. We find sales varying from 0% to 60%. Behavior change promotion that combined door-to-door personalized demonstrations with information pamphlets was effective. When given a choice amongst products, households strongly preferred an electric stove over improved biomass-burning options. Among different stove attributes, reduced cooking time was considered most valuable by those adopting a new stove. Households clearly identified price as a significant barrier to adoption, while provision of discounts (e.g., rebates given if households used the stove) or payments in installments were related to higher purchase. Place-based factors such as remoteness and nongovernmental organization operations significantly affected the ability to supply and convince households to buy and use improved cookstoves. Collectively, these pilots point to the importance of continued and extensive testing of messages, pricing models, and different stove types before scale-up. Thus, we caution that a one-size-fits-all approach will not boost improved cookstove adoption.
abstract_zh: 尽管改良炉灶有潜力减少固体燃料使用对环境和健康的不利影响，但其采用率和使用率仍然很低。社会营销以促销、产品、价格和渠道（place）的营销组合为重点，为理解家庭行为和设计改变生物质燃料使用的运动提供了一种有益的途径。我们报告了在印度3个邦开展的一系列试点，这些试点采用了不同的营销组合。我们发现销售量从0%到60%不等。将挨家挨户的个性化演示与信息宣传册相结合的行为改变宣传是有效的。在可在多种产品间选择时，家庭强烈偏好电炉，而不是改良的生物质燃烧方案。在各种炉灶属性中，采用新炉灶的家庭认为缩短烹饪时间最有价值。家庭明确将价格视为采用的重要障碍，而提供折扣（例如，若家庭使用该炉灶则给予返还）或分期付款与更高的购买率相关。偏远程度和非政府组织运作等地方性因素，显著影响了供应改良炉灶以及说服家庭购买和使用的能力。总体而言，这些试点表明，在大规模推广之前，持续、广泛地测试宣传信息、定价模式和不同炉灶类型十分重要。因此，我们提醒，“一刀切”的做法无法提升改良炉灶的采用率。

title: Preferences for improved cook stoves: Evidence from rural villages in north India
abstract: Because emissions from solid fuel burning in traditional stoves impact global climate change, the regional environment, and household health, there is today real interest in improved cook stoves (ICS). Nonetheless, surprisingly little is known about what households like about these energy products. We report on preferences for biomass-burning ICS attributes in a large sample of 2120 rural households in north India, a global hotspot for biomass fuel use and the damages that such use entails. Households have a strong baseline reliance and preference for traditional stoves, a preference that outweighs the $10 and $5 willingness to pay (WTP) for realistic (33%) reductions in smoke emissions and fuel needs on average, respectively. Preferences for stove attributes are also highly varied, and correlated with a number of household characteristics (e.g. expenditures, gender of household head, patience and risk preferences). These results suggest that households exhibit cautious interest in some aspects of ICS, but that widespread adoption is unlikely because many households appear to prefer traditional stoves over ICS with similar characteristics. The policy community must therefore support a reinvigorated supply chain with complementary infrastructure investments, foster experimentation with products, encourage continued applied research and knowledge generation, and provide appropriate incentives to consumers, if ICS distribution is to be scaled up.
abstract_zh: 由于传统炉灶中固体燃料燃烧所产生的排放会影响全球气候变化、区域环境和家庭健康，如今人们对改良炉灶（ICS）产生了切实的兴趣。然而，令人惊讶的是，人们对家庭究竟喜欢这些能源产品的哪些方面所知甚少。我们报告了印度北部2120户农村家庭大样本中对生物质燃烧型改良炉灶属性的偏好，该地区是生物质燃料使用及其所带来损害的全球热点地区。家庭对传统炉灶有很强的基线依赖和偏好，这一偏好超过了平均而言为实现现实的（33%）烟雾排放和燃料需求减少而愿意支付的10美元和5美元的支付意愿（WTP）。家庭对炉灶属性的偏好也差异很大，并与若干家庭特征（如支出、户主性别、耐心和风险偏好）相关。这些结果表明，家庭对改良炉灶的某些方面表现出谨慎的兴趣，但由于许多家庭似乎更偏好传统炉灶，而非具有类似特征的改良炉灶，因此广泛采用不太可能实现。因此，如果要扩大改良炉灶的分发规模，政策界必须支持重振供应链并辅以互补的基础设施投资，促进产品试验，鼓励持续的应用研究和知识生成，并为消费者提供适当的激励。

title: Public health impacts of ecosystem change in the Brazilian Amazon
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Nature threads the very fabric of human lives in remote forest areas of developing countries. Unfortunately, we do not fully understand how ecosystem services (such as human health benefits) could be secured by conserving natural capital. Thus, we analyze a rich dataset on disease, climate, demography, land uses, and conservation policies in the Brazilian Amazon. Unsurprisingly, we find that the health dividends vary across conservation policies and are small relative to the overall burden of these diseases. However, interventions targeted specifically at preserving biodiversity (strict protected areas) generate health cobenefits. Thus, given a chance, nature does its part for human (health) capital, especially for the poor and politically voiceless.
abstract_zh: 在发展中国家偏远的森林地区，自然深深交织于人们生活的肌理之中。遗憾的是，我们并未充分理解通过保护自然资本，如何能够确保生态系统服务（如对人类健康的益处）。因此，我们分析了巴西亚马逊地区关于疾病、气候、人口、土地利用和保护政策的丰富数据集。不出所料，我们发现健康红利因保护政策而异，且相对于这些疾病的总体负担而言规模较小。然而，专门旨在保护生物多样性的干预措施（严格的保护区）产生了健康上的协同效益。因此，只要有机会，自然就会为人类（健康）资本做出自己的贡献，尤其是对贫困人口和政治上缺乏话语权的人群。

title: Safeguarding human health in the Anthropocene epoch: report of The Rockefeller Foundation-Lancet Commission on planetary health
Social and Environmental Impacts of Forest Management Certification in Indonesia
abstract: In response to unsustainable timber production in tropical forest concessions, voluntary forest management certification programs such as the Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) have been introduced to improve environmental, social, and economic performance over existing management practices. However, despite the proliferation of forest certification over the past two decades, few studies have evaluated its effectiveness. Using temporally and spatially explicit village-level data on environmental and socio-economic indicators in Kalimantan (Indonesia), we evaluate the performance of the FSC-certified timber concessions compared to non-certified logging concessions. Employing triple difference matching estimators, we find that between 2000 and 2008 FSC reduced aggregate deforestation by 5 percentage points and the incidence of air pollution by 31%. It had no statistically significant impacts on fire incidence or core areas, but increased forest perforation by 4 km2 on average. In addition, we find that FSC reduced firewood dependence (by 33%), respiratory infections (by 32%) and malnutrition (by 1 person) on average. By conducting a rigorous statistical evaluation of FSC certification in a biodiversity hotspot such as Indonesia, we provide a reference point and offer methodological and data lessons that could aid the design of ongoing and future evaluations of a potentially critical conservation policy.
abstract_zh: 为应对热带森林特许经营中不可持续的木材生产，森林管理认证项目（如森林管理委员会（FSC））作为自愿性项目被引入，旨在使环境、社会和经济表现优于现有的管理做法。然而，尽管过去二十年森林认证激增，却很少有研究评估其成效。利用印度尼西亚加里曼丹（Kalimantan）村庄层面的时空明确的环境和社会经济指标数据，我们比较了获得FSC认证的木材特许经营与未经认证的伐木特许经营的表现。采用三重差分匹配估计量，我们发现2000至2008年间，FSC使总体森林砍伐减少了5个百分点，空气污染发生率降低了31%。它对火灾发生率或核心区面积没有统计上显著的影响，但平均使森林穿孔（forest perforation）增加了4平方千米。此外，我们发现FSC平均减少了柴薪依赖（33%）、呼吸道感染（32%）和营养不良（1人）。通过对印度尼西亚这样一个生物多样性热点地区的FSC认证进行严格的统计评估，我们提供了一个参照点，并提出了方法论和数据层面的经验，这可以帮助设计对一项潜在关键保护政策正在进行和未来的评估。

title: The economics of household air pollution
abstract: Traditional energy technologies and consumer products contribute to household well-being in diverse ways but also often harm household air quality. We review the problem of household air pollution at a global scale, focusing particularly on the harmful effects of traditional cooking and heating. Drawing on the theory of household production, we illustrate the ambiguous relationship between household well-being and adoption of behaviors and technologies that reduce air pollution. We then review how the theory relates to the seemingly contradictory findings emerging from the literature on developing country household demand for clean fuels and stoves. In conclusion, we describe an economics research agenda to close the knowledge gaps so that policies and programs can be designed and evaluated to solve the global household air pollution problem.
abstract_zh: 传统能源技术和消费品以多种方式促进家庭福祉，但往往也损害家庭空气质量。我们在全球范围内回顾了家庭空气污染问题，尤其关注传统烹饪和取暖的有害影响。借鉴家庭生产理论，我们说明了家庭福祉与采用减少空气污染的行为和技术之间模糊的关系。随后，我们回顾了该理论如何与发展中国家家庭对清洁燃料和炉灶需求的文献中出现的看似矛盾的发现相联系。最后，我们描述了一项经济学研究议程，以填补知识空白，从而能够设计和评估政策与项目，解决全球家庭空气污染问题。

title: Water and sanitation economics: Reflections on application to developing economies
Have We Managed to Integrate Conservation and Development? ICDP Impacts in the Brazilian Amazon
abstract: Integrating conservation and development is central to the mission of many protected areas in the tropics, yet there is limited empirical evidence on the effectiveness of alternative strategies for ICDPs (Integrated Conservation and Development Projects). We evaluate an enterprise-based conservation strategy in a high-profile and well-funded ICDP in the Tapajós National Forest of Brazil. Using survey data from participating and non-participating households collected pre and post intervention, we find positive impacts on household income, but almost no discernible impacts on household assets, livelihood portfolios, or forest conservation.
abstract_zh: 将保护与发展相结合是热带地区许多保护区使命的核心，然而，关于综合保护与发展项目（ICDP）替代策略有效性的实证证据有限。我们评估了巴西塔帕若斯国家森林（Tapajós National Forest）中一个备受关注、资金充足的ICDP所采用的基于企业的保护策略。利用干预前后参与家庭与非参与家庭的调查数据，我们发现其对家庭收入有正面影响，但对家庭资产、生计组合或森林保护几乎没有可辨别的影响。

title: How do people in rural India perceive improved stoves and clean fuel? Evidence from Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand
venue: International journal of environmental research and public health
abstract: Improved cook stoves (ICS) have been widely touted for their potential to deliver the triple benefits of improved household health and time savings, reduced deforestation and local environmental degradation, and reduced emissions of black carbon, a significant short-term contributor to global climate change. Yet diffusion of ICS technologies among potential users in many low-income settings, including India, remains slow, despite decades of promotion. This paper explores the variation in perceptions of and preferences for ICS in Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand, as revealed through a series of semi-structured focus groups and interviews from 11 rural villages or hamlets. We find cautious interest in new ICS technologies, and observe that preferences for ICS are positively related to perceptions of health and time savings. Other respondent and community characteristics, e.g., gender, education, prior experience with clean stoves and institutions promoting similar technologies, and social norms as perceived through the actions of neighbours, also appear important. Though they cannot be considered representative, our results suggest that efforts to increase adoption and use of ICS in rural India will likely require a combination of supply-chain improvements and carefully designed social marketing and promotion campaigns, and possibly incentives, to reduce the up-front cost of stoves.
abstract_zh: 改良炉灶（ICS）因其有望同时带来三重效益而受到广泛推崇：改善家庭健康并节省时间、减少毁林和当地环境退化，以及减少黑碳排放（黑碳是全球气候变化中一个显著的短期促成因素）。然而，尽管经过了数十年的推广，包括印度在内的许多低收入地区，潜在用户中改良炉灶技术的扩散仍然缓慢。本文通过在北方邦（Uttar Pradesh）和北阿坎德邦（Uttarakhand）11个农村村庄或村落开展的一系列半结构化焦点小组讨论和访谈，探讨了人们对改良炉灶的认知和偏好的差异。我们发现人们对新型改良炉灶技术持谨慎的兴趣，并观察到对改良炉灶的偏好与对健康和节省时间的认知呈正相关。其他受访者和社区特征，例如性别、教育程度、以往使用清洁炉灶的经验、推广类似技术的机构，以及通过邻居行为所感知到的社会规范，似乎也很重要。尽管这些结果不具有代表性，但它们表明，要在印度农村提高改良炉灶的采用和使用率，很可能需要综合运用供应链改善、精心设计的社会营销与宣传运动，并可能需要激励措施，以降低炉灶的前期成本。

title: Preference Heterogeneity and Adoption of Environmental Health Improvements: Evidence from a Cookstove Promotion Experiment
Preferences for Improved Cook Stoves: Evidence from North Indian Villages
Social marketing of water and sanitation products: a systematic review of peer-reviewed literature
abstract: Like commercial marketing, social marketing uses the 4 "Ps" and seeks exchange of value between the marketer and consumer. Behaviors such as handwashing, and products such as those for oral rehydration treatment (ORT), can be marketed like commercial products in developing countries. Although social marketing in these areas is growing, there has been no systematic review of the current state of practice, research and evaluation. We searched the literature for published peer-reviewed studies available through major online publication databases. We identified manuscripts in the health, social science, and business literature on social marketing that used at least one of the 4 Ps of marketing and had a behavioral objective targeting the behaviors or products related to improving water and sanitation. We developed formalized decision rules and applied them in identifying articles for review. We initially identified 117 articles and reviewed a final set of 32 that met our criteria. Social marketing is a widespread strategy. Marketing efforts have created high levels of awareness of health threats and solutions, including behavior change and socially marketed products. There is widespread use of the 4 Ps of marketing, with price interventions being the least common. Evaluations show consistent improvements in behavioral mediators but mixed results in behavior change. Interventions have successfully used social marketing following widely recommended strategies. Future evaluations need to focus on mediators that explain successful behavior change in order to identify best practices and improve future programs. More rigorous evaluations including quasi-experimental designs and randomized trials are needed. More consistent reporting of evaluation results that permits meta-analysis of effects is needed.
abstract_zh: 与商业营销一样，社会营销也运用4个“P”（营销组合），并寻求营销者与消费者之间的价值交换。洗手等行为以及口服补液疗法（ORT）产品等，都可以像商业产品一样在发展中国家进行营销。尽管这些地区的社会营销正在增长，但尚无对其实践、研究和评估现状进行的系统综述。我们在通过主要在线出版数据库可获得的已发表同行评议研究中检索文献。我们识别出健康、社会科学和商业文献中关于社会营销的论文，这些论文使用了营销4个P中的至少一个，并且具有针对改善水和卫生相关行为或产品的行为目标。我们制定了正式化的决策规则，并将其应用于筛选纳入综述的文章。我们最初识别出117篇文章，最终纳入了符合标准的32篇进行综述。社会营销是一种广泛采用的策略。营销努力已在健康威胁及其解决方案方面形成了高度的认知，包括行为改变和社会营销产品。4个P的营销手段被广泛使用，其中价格干预最为少见。评估显示，行为中介变量持续改善，但行为改变的结果不一。干预措施成功地遵循广泛推荐的策略运用了社会营销。未来的评估需要关注能够解释成功行为改变的中介变量，以便识别最佳实践并改进未来的项目。需要包括准实验设计和随机试验在内的更严格的评估。还需要更一致地报告评估结果，以便进行效应的元分析。

title: More strictly protected areas are not necessarily more protective: Evidence from Bolivia, Costa Rica, Indonesia, and Thailand
abstract: National parks and other protected areas are at the forefront of global efforts to protect biodiversity and ecosystem services. However, not all protection is equal. Some areas are assigned strict legal protection that permits few extractive human uses. Other protected area designations permit a wider range of uses. Whether strictly protected areas are more effective in achieving environmental objectives is an empirical question: although strictly protected areas legally permit less anthropogenic disturbance, the social conflicts associated with assigning strict protection may lead politicians to assign strict protection to less-threatened areas and may lead citizens or enforcement agents to ignore the strict legal restrictions. We contrast the impacts of strictly and less strictly protected areas in four countries using IUCN designations to measure de jure strictness, data on deforestation to measure outcomes, and a quasi-experimental design to estimate impacts. On average, stricter protection reduced deforestation rates more than less strict protection, but the additional impact was not always large and sometimes arose because of where stricter protection was assigned rather than regulatory strictness per se. We also show that, in protected area studies contrasting y management regimes, there are y2 policy-relevant impacts, rather than only y (squared), as earlier studies have implied.
abstract_zh: 国家公园和其他保护区处于全球保护生物多样性和生态系统服务努力的前沿。然而，并非所有保护都是同等的。一些地区被赋予严格的法律保护，只允许极少的采掘性人类利用。其他保护区类别则允许更广泛的利用。严格保护区在实现环境目标方面是否更有效，是一个实证问题：尽管严格保护区在法律上允许的人为干扰较少，但与赋予严格保护相关的社会冲突可能导致政治家将严格保护分配给威胁较小的地区，也可能导致公民或执法人员无视严格的法律限制。我们利用国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）的分类来衡量法定的严格程度，以森林砍伐率衡量结果，并采用准实验设计估计影响，对四个国家的严格保护区与不太严格保护区的影响进行了对比。平均而言，更严格的保护比不太严格的保护更能降低森林砍伐率，但额外影响并不总是很大，有时其产生是由于严格保护被分配到的地点，而非监管严格程度本身。我们还表明，在对比不同管理制度的保护区研究中，存在y2政策相关影响，而不仅仅是先前研究所暗示的y（平方）。

title: Are benefit transfers using a joint revealed and stated preference model more accurate than revealed and stated preference data alone?
Benefits and costs of improved cookstoves: assessing the implications of variability in health, forest and climate impacts
abstract: Current attention to improved cook stoves (ICS) focuses on the "triple benefits" they provide, in improved health and time savings for households, in preservation of forests and associated ecosystem services, and in reducing emissions that contribute to global climate change. Despite the purported economic benefits of such technologies, however, progress in achieving large-scale adoption and use has been remarkably slow. This paper uses Monte Carlo simulation analysis to evaluate the claim that households will always reap positive and large benefits from the use of such technologies. Our analysis allows for better understanding of the variability in economic costs and benefits of ICS use in developing countries, which depend on unknown combinations of numerous uncertain parameters. The model results suggest that the private net benefits of ICS will sometimes be negative, and in many instances highly so. Moreover, carbon financing and social subsidies may help enhance incentives to adopt, but will not always be appropriate. The costs and benefits of these technologies are most affected by their relative fuel costs, time and fuel use efficiencies, the incidence and cost-of-illness of acute respiratory illness, and the cost of household cooking time. Combining these results with the fact that households often find these technologies to be inconvenient or culturally inappropriate leads us to understand why uptake has been disappointing. Given the current attention to the scale up of ICS, this analysis is timely and important for highlighting some of the challenges for global efforts to promote ICS.
abstract_zh: 当前对改良炉灶（ICS）的关注集中于它们提供的“三重效益”：改善家庭健康和节省时间，保护森林及相关生态系统服务，以及减少导致全球气候变化的排放。然而，尽管这些技术据称具有经济效益，其大规模采用和使用的进展却异常缓慢。本文使用蒙特卡洛模拟分析，评估了家庭将始终从使用此类技术中获得正向且巨大收益这一主张。我们的分析有助于更好地理解发展中国家使用改良炉灶的经济成本和收益的变异性，这些成本和收益取决于众多不确定参数的未知组合。模型结果表明，改良炉灶的私人净收益有时为负，并且在许多情况下负值很大。此外，碳融资和社会补贴可能有助于增强采用的激励，但并不总是适当的。这些技术的成本和收益受其相对燃料成本、时间和燃料使用效率、急性呼吸道疾病的发病率及其疾病成本，以及家庭烹饪时间成本的影响最大。将这些结果与家庭通常认为这些技术不方便或在文化上不适宜的事实结合起来，我们便能理解为何其普及令人失望。鉴于当前对扩大改良炉灶规模的关注，本分析及时且重要，它揭示了全球推广改良炉灶努力所面临的一些挑战。

title: Benefits transfer of a third kind: An examination of structural benefits transfer
Consumer preferences for household water treatment products in Andhra Pradesh, India
abstract: Over 5 billion people worldwide are exposed to unsafe water. Given the obstacles to ensuring sustainable improvements in water supply infrastructure and the unhygienic handling of water after collection, household water treatment and storage (HWTS) products have been viewed as important mechanisms for increasing access to safe water. Although studies have shown that HWTS technologies can reduce the likelihood of diarrheal illness by about 30%, levels of adoption and continued use remain low. An understanding of household preferences for HWTS products can be used to create demand through effective product positioning and social marketing, and ultimately improve and ensure commercial sustainability and scalability of these products. However, there has been little systematic research on consumer preferences for HWTS products. This paper reports the results of the first state-of-the-art conjoint analysis study of HWTS products. In 2008, we conducted a conjoint analysis survey of a representative sample of households in Andhra Pradesh (AP), India to elicit and quantify household preferences for commercial HWTS products. Controlling for attribute non-attendance in an error components mixed logit model, the study results indicate that the most important features to respondents, in terms of the effect on utility, were the type of product, followed by the extent to which the product removes pathogens, the retail outlet and, the time required to treat 10 L. Holding all other product attributes constant, filters were preferred to combination products and chemical additives. Department stores and weekly markets were the most favorable sales outlets, followed by mobile salespeople. In general, households do not prefer to purchase HWTS products at local shops. Our results can inform the types of products and sales outlets that are likely to be successful in commercial HWTS markets in AP, as well as the influence of different pricing and financing strategies on product demand and uptake.
abstract_zh: 全球有超过50亿人接触不安全的饮用水。鉴于在确保供水基础设施可持续改善以及水在收集后处理不卫生等方面存在障碍，家庭水处理与储存（HWTS）产品被视为增加安全饮用水可及性的重要机制。尽管研究表明，HWTS技术可将腹泻疾病的可能性降低约30%，但其采用率和持续使用率仍然很低。了解家庭对HWTS产品的偏好，可以通过有效的产品定位和社会营销来创造需求，并最终提高和保障这些产品的商业可持续性与可扩展性。然而，关于消费者对HWTS产品偏好的系统性研究很少。本文报告了首个关于HWTS产品的前沿联合分析研究的结果。2008年，我们在印度安得拉邦（AP）对具有代表性的家庭样本进行了联合分析调查，以诱导并量化家庭对商业HWTS产品的偏好。在误差成分混合Logit模型中控制属性不关注（attribute non-attendance）后，研究结果表明，就对效用的影响而言，受访者最重视的特征依次为产品类型，其次是产品去除病原体的程度、零售渠道，以及处理10升水所需的时间。在保持其他产品属性不变的情况下，过滤器比组合产品和化学添加剂更受青睐。百货商店和每周集市是最受欢迎的销售渠道，其次是流动销售人员。总体而言，家庭不倾向于在当地商店购买HWTS产品。我们的结果可以为哪些产品类型和销售渠道在安得拉邦的商业HWTS市场中可能取得成功提供参考，也可为不同定价和融资策略对产品需求和采用的影响提供参考。

title: Deforestation and malaria: Revisiting the human ecology perspective
Do payments for environmental services affect forest cover? A farm-level evaluation from Costa Rica
abstract: Payments for environmental services (PES) are popular despite little empirical evidence of their effectiveness. We estimate the impact of PES on forest cover in a region known for exemplary implementation of one of the best-known and longest-lived PES programs. Our evaluation design combines sampling that incorporates prematching, data from remote sensing and household surveys, and empirical methods that include partial identification with weak assumptions, difference-in-differences matching estimators, and tests of sensitivity to unobservable heterogeneity. PES in our study site increased participating farm forest cover by about 11% to 17% of the mean area under PES contract over eight years. (JEL Q57, Q58)
abstract_zh: 尽管关于其有效性的实证证据很少，环境服务付费（PES）仍然很受欢迎。我们在一个以实施最著名、运行时间最长的PES项目之一而闻名的地区，估计PES对森林覆盖的影响。我们的评估设计结合了：纳入预匹配的抽样、遥感和家庭调查数据，以及一系列实证方法，包括弱假设下的部分识别、双重差分匹配估计量，以及对不可观测异质性的敏感性检验。在我们的研究地点，PES使参与农场的森林覆盖在八年内增加了相当于PES合同平均面积的11%至17%。（JEL Q57, Q58）

title: Evaluation of biodiversity policy instruments: What works and what doesn't?
abstract: We review and confirm the claim that credible evaluations of common conservation instruments continue to be rare. The limited set of rigorous studies suggests that protected areas cause modest reductions in deforestation; however, the evidence base for payments for ecosystem services, decentralization policies and other interventions is much weaker. Thus, we renew our urgent call for more evaluations from many more biodiversity-relevant locations. Specifically, we call for a programme of research—Conservation Evaluation 2.0—that seeks to measure how programme impacts vary by socio-political and bio-physical context, to track economic and environmental impacts jointly, to identify spatial spillover effects to untargeted areas, and to use theories of change to characterize causal mechanisms that can guide the collection of data and the interpretation of results. Only then can we usefully contribute to the debate over how to protect biodiversity in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾并证实了以下论断：对常见保护工具进行可信的评估仍然罕见。有限的严格研究表明，保护区只能适度减少森林砍伐；然而，关于生态系统服务付费、分权政策和其他干预措施的证据基础则薄弱得多。因此，我们再次迫切呼吁，在更多与生物多样性相关的地点开展更多评估。具体而言，我们呼吁开展一项研究计划——“保护评估2.0”（Conservation Evaluation 2.0）——旨在衡量项目影响如何随社会政治和生物物理背景而变化，共同追踪经济和环境影响，识别对非目标地区的空间溢出效应，并利用变化理论来刻画因果机制，从而指导数据收集和结果解释。只有这样，我们才能对发展中国家如何保护生物多样性的辩论作出有益贡献。

title: Forest figures: Ecosystem services valuation and policy evaluation in developing countries
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: We review the evidence on the economic values of forest ecosystem services in developing nations and the effectiveness of policies aimed at protecting these services. We conclude that, despite a plethora of publications, the literature is thin, with few well-designed studies that can provide a coherent picture of ecosystem values or policy effectiveness. Although ecologists coined the term ecosystem services and have led much of the recent research, ecosystem services is fundamentally an economic concept. This offers economists a unique and important opportunity to contribute to the emerging literature on ecosystem valuation and policy effectiveness. Most importantly, we conclude that the most fruitful path for future inquiry is to more tightly integrate policy and research by conducting studies that combine nonmarket valuation and impact evaluation (i.e., valuation estimates based on observed impacts in the context of real-world programs). We believe that investing scarce research funds in such an integrated approach will increase the likelihood that future research on ecosystem services will yield high-quality evidence of practical use to policymakers.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了发展中国家森林生态系统服务经济价值的证据，以及旨在保护这些服务的政策的有效性。我们得出结论：尽管出版物大量涌现，但文献仍然单薄，设计良好、能够提供关于生态系统价值或政策有效性连贯图景的研究寥寥无几。尽管生态学家创造了“生态系统服务”一词，并引领了近期的大部分研究，但生态系统服务从根本上说是一个经济学概念。这为经济学家提供了独特而重要的机会，去为新兴的生态系统估值和政策有效性文献作出贡献。最重要的是，我们得出结论：未来研究最富成效的路径，是更紧密地整合政策与研究，开展结合非市场估值与影响评估（即基于现实世界项目中观察到的影响得出的估值估计）的研究。我们相信，将稀缺的研究经费投入这种整合性方法，将提高未来生态系统服务研究产生对政策制定者具有实际用途的高质量证据的可能性。

title: National parks as conservation and development projects: Gauging local support
The effect of water quality testing on household behavior: evidence from an experiment in rural India
venue: The American journal of tropical medicine and hygiene
abstract: How does specific information about contamination in a household's drinking water affect water handling behavior? We randomly split a sample of households in rural Andhra Pradesh, India. The treatment group observed a contamination test of the drinking water in their own household storage vessel; while they were waiting for their results, they were also provided with a list of actions that they could take to remedy contamination if they tested positive. The control group received no test or guidance. The drinking water of nearly 90% of tested households showed evidence of contamination by fecal bacteria. They reacted by purchasing more of their water from commercial sources but not by making more time-intensive adjustments. Providing salient evidence of risk increases demand for commercial clean water.
abstract_zh: 家庭饮用水中的具体污染信息如何影响其水处理行为？我们在印度安得拉邦农村地区随机划分了一组家庭样本。处理组观察了其自家储水容器中饮用水的污染检测；在等待结果期间，他们还获得了一份行动清单，如果检测呈阳性，可以采取这些行动来补救污染。对照组既没有接受检测，也没有得到指导。在接受检测的家庭中，近90%的饮用水显示出粪便细菌污染的证据。他们的反应是从商业来源购买更多的水，而不是进行更耗费时间的调整。提供显著的风险证据会增加对商业清洁水的需求。

title: Who adopts improved fuels and cookstoves? A systematic review
abstract:
Background: The global focus on improved cookstoves (ICSs) and clean fuels has increased because of their potential for delivering triple dividends: household health, local environmental quality, and regional climate benefits. However, ICS and clean fuel dissemination programs have met with low rates of adoption.
Objectives: We reviewed empirical studies on ICSs and fuel choice to describe the literature, examine determinants of fuel and stove choice, and identify knowledge gaps.
Methods: We conducted a systematic review of the literature on the adoption of ICSs or cleaner fuels by households in developing countries. Results are synthesized through a simple vote-counting meta-analysis.
Results: We identified 32 research studies that reported 146 separate regression analyses of ICS adoption (11 analyses) or fuel choice (135 analyses) from Asia (60%), Africa (27%), and Latin America (19%). Most studies apply multivariate regression methods to consider 7–13 determinants of choice. Income, education, and urban location were positively associated with adoption in most but not all studies. However, the influence of fuel availability and prices, household size and composition, and sex is unclear. Potentially important drivers such as credit, supply-chain strengthening, and social marketing have been ignored.
Conclusions: Adoption studies of ICSs or clean energy are scarce, scattered, and of differential quality, even though global distribution programs are quickly expanding. Future research should examine an expanded set of contextual variables to improve implementation of stove programs that can realize the “win-win-win” of health, local environmental quality, and climate associated with these technologies.
abstract_zh:
背景：由于改良炉灶（ICS）和清洁燃料有望带来三重红利——家庭健康、当地环境质量和区域气候效益，全球对其的关注度日益提高。然而，ICS和清洁燃料的推广项目采用率一直较低。
目的：我们回顾了关于ICS和燃料选择的实证研究，以描述相关文献，考察燃料和炉灶选择的决定因素，并识别知识空白。
方法：我们对发展中国家家庭采用ICS或清洁燃料的文献进行了系统综述。结果通过简单的计数投票元分析进行综合。
结果：我们识别出32项研究，报告了146项独立的回归分析，其中包括ICS采用的回归分析（11项）和燃料选择的回归分析（135项），研究来自亚洲（60%）、非洲（27%）和拉丁美洲（19%）。大多数研究应用多元回归方法，考虑7至13个选择决定因素。收入、教育程度和城市位置在大多数（但并非全部）研究中与采用呈正相关。然而，燃料可得性和价格、家庭规模与构成以及性别的影响尚不明确。信贷、供应链加强和社会营销等潜在的重要驱动因素则被忽视了。
结论：尽管全球分发项目正在迅速扩张，但关于ICS或清洁能源采用的研究仍然稀少、分散，且质量参差不齐。未来的研究应考察更广泛的背景变量，以改进炉灶项目的实施，从而实现与这些技术相关的健康、当地环境质量和气候方面的“三赢”。

title: Do ICDPs work? An empirical evaluation of forest-based microenterprises in the Brazilian Amazon
abstract: This paper evaluates public investments in forest-based microenterprises as part of an integrated conservation and development project (ICDP) in the Brazilian Amazon. We combine matching with regression to quantify the effects of program participation on household income, wealth, and livelihoods. We find that participation increased cash and total income and asset accumulation, suggesting that the microenterprises contributed to the development goals of the ICDP. There is no clear evidence, however, that the microenterprise program helped achieve the ICDP’s conservation goals of shifting household livelihoods away from agriculture and into sustainable forest use. (JEL O12, O13)
abstract_zh: 本文评估了作为巴西亚马逊地区综合保护与发展项目（ICDP）一部分的、针对森林类微型企业的公共投资。我们将匹配与回归相结合，以量化项目参与对家庭收入、财富和生计的影响。我们发现，参与提高了现金收入和总收入以及资产积累，表明微型企业促进了ICDP的发展目标。然而，没有明确证据表明该微型企业项目帮助实现了ICDP的保护目标，即将家庭生计从农业转向可持续的森林利用。（JEL O12, O13）

title: Under-mining health: environmental justice and mining in India
abstract: Despite the potential for economic growth, extractive mineral industries can impose negative health externalities in mining communities. We estimate the size of these externalities by combining household interviews with mine location and estimating statistical functions of respiratory illness and malaria among villagers living along a gradient of proximity to iron-ore mines in rural India. Two-stage regression modeling with cluster corrections suggests that villagers living closer to mines had higher respiratory illness and malaria-related workday loss, but the evidence for mine workers is mixed. These findings contribute to the thin empirical literature on environmental justice and public health in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 尽管采掘性矿业具有经济增长的潜力，但它可能在矿区社区中施加负面的健康外部性。我们通过将家庭访谈与矿山位置相结合，并估计沿着与印度农村铁矿距离梯度居住的村民中呼吸道疾病和疟疾的统计函数，来估算这些外部性的规模。采用带聚类修正的两阶段回归模型表明，居住在离矿山更近的村民呼吸道疾病发病率更高，且因疟疾导致的误工日数更多，但对矿工而言证据并不一致。这些发现为发展中国家环境正义与公共卫生方面稀少的实证文献作出了贡献。
